Rows are an ordered list whose direction is spoken as well as drawn, and the settled total is announced politely and reported through onTotalChange from the effect that observed it.

props.name: entries
props.description: The movements, newest first: id, label, signed amount and an optional note.

props.name: openingBalance
props.description: The figure the entries move from; the total is this plus every entry passed.

props.name: max
props.description: Rows kept on screen; older ones leave on the exit ease but still count toward the total.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tally and titles the total.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the total. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: formatDelta
props.description: Formats a row's amount, so the sign always shows.

props.name: onTotalChange
props.description: Fires from the effect that observes a new total, never during render.

usageNotes: Nothing here runs on a clock: entries arrive because the host passed them, so a demo or a feed decides the pace and there is no timer to leak.
Each row's direction is announced as a word ("Credit", "Debit") and the total is read by a polite status region, so the arrows' colour is never the only cue.
Under reduced motion rows fade into place with no side travel and the digits swap, but the order still changes and the oldest row still leaves, because the order is the record.

items.title: Statement Fold
items.tagline: A month you can open like a letter.
items.description: A month's statement folded in three: pressing the header unfolds income, spend and net, each rotating from -90 degrees about its own top edge on glide in a cascade, so the letter opens from the top down instead of all at once. Folding back reverses the order on the exit ease, and the card's height comes from a ResizeObserver on the open content rather than a reserved minimum. Each panel's bar draws with scaleX against the largest of the three figures, the net colours by sign and never bounces, and the header is a real aria-expanded button that Enter, Space and Escape drive.

props.name: month
props.description: The statement's month, as printed.

props.name: year
props.description: Optional year beside the month.

props.name: accountName
props.description: The account the statement belongs to, printed under the month.

props.name: income
props.description: Money in, major units.

props.name: spend
props.description: Money out, positive major units.

props.name: net
props.description: Overrides the computed net when the host has its own figure.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial fold state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that changed it.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats an unsigned amount; the card composes the signs itself.

usageNotes: The header is a real button carrying aria-expanded and aria-controls: Enter and Space unfold it, Escape folds the card and returns focus to the header.
The panels are a dl of dt/dd pairs inside a labelled region, so income, spend and net are read as labelled amounts rather than loose numbers.
Under reduced motion nothing rotates: the panels arrive in sequence by opacity alone and the height changes instantly, while the bars still draw their proportions.

items.title: Reserve Gauge
items.tagline: How much of this is actually yours.
items.description: A balance bar split to scale between spendable money and the holds sitting on it, each hold hatched and sized by its share. Clearing a hold shrinks its segment away on the exit ease while the available run glides wider and the figure rolls its digits on snap; a reader caret slides to whichever segment is being read on snap. The holds are one Tab stop with a roving tabindex — Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Enter pins the reason open, Escape unpins.

props.name: total
props.description: Cleared balance, holds included.

props.name: holds
props.description: Each hold's id, amount, reason and clearing note, drawn left to right.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the account and labels the bar.

props.name: format
props.description: Renders every amount; the locale is pinned so the server and client agree.

props.name: activeHoldId / defaultActiveHoldId
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned hold — the one whose reason stays open.

props.name: onActiveHoldChange
props.description: Fires from the press that pinned or unpinned a hold.

props.name: onHoldReveal
props.description: Fires when hover or focus changes which reason is showing.

usageNotes: The holds are one Tab stop with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step between segments, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pins a reason open, Escape unpins.
Under reduced motion the segment widths still redraw and the figure still updates — on a tween instead of a spring, with no digit roll — because the split is the information.
Amounts always go through `format`; a hold smaller than a twentieth of the bar keeps a floor width so it stays readable and hittable.

items.title: Balance Compare
items.tagline: Two months, one honest line.
items.description: Two periods stand on columns scaled against the larger of the pair, and hovering or focusing draws a line between the column tops with pathLength on flick — the line is the assertion, so it lands at once. It colours by direction and carries a caret so up and down never rest on colour alone, while a percent chip arrives at its midpoint on snap from a nudge below and the columns glide to new heights. Enter or Space pins the line open for touch and keyboard readers, Escape releases it.

props.name: from
props.description: The earlier period: its label and amount, drawn on the left.

props.name: to
props.description: The later period: its label and amount, drawn on the right.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being compared; names the control.

props.name: format
props.description: Renders both figures and the delta when there is no percentage to give.

props.name: pinned / defaultPinned
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned state — the line and chip stay drawn.

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that pinned or released the line.

props.name: onRevealChange
props.description: Fires when the line becomes visible or hides, from hover, focus or a pin.

usageNotes: The whole instrument is one button: Tab reaches it, hover or focus draws the line, Enter or Space pins it, Escape releases it. Its accessible name carries the entire comparison as a sentence.
Under reduced motion the line appears at full length on an opacity tween and the chip fades in place — the direction, caret, colour and percentage are unchanged.
A `from` of zero has no percentage to give, so the chip shows the money moved instead of dividing by zero.

items.title: Cash Clock
items.tagline: Payday is a countdown, not a surprise.
items.description: A ring that fills toward payday one tick per day, its spent arc growing on glide because a cycle is a quantity settling rather than a switch flipping. Inside sits the balance you will actually reach: switching a scheduled outgoing on or off counts the projection to its new figure on snap through a motion value and lands or lifts that outgoing's marker on the day it falls, and a projection under the floor turns the unspent arc danger. The outgoings are real checkboxes, so Tab reaches each one and Space toggles it.

props.name: balance
props.description: Balance today, before the scheduled outgoings.

props.name: daysToPayday
props.description: Days left in the cycle; clamped into cycleDays. Never read from the clock.

props.name: cycleDays
props.description: Ticks on the ring — the length of the pay cycle.

props.name: outgoings
props.description: Scheduled debits: id, label, amount and the day each lands.

props.name: included / defaultIncluded
props.description: Controlled or initial ids counted in the projection.

props.name: onIncludedChange
props.description: Fires from the checkbox that changed.

props.name: onProjectionChange
props.description: Fires with the new projection after a toggle.

props.name: floor
props.description: A projection below this reads danger and shows what you are short by.

props.name: format
props.description: Renders the projection and every row; the locale is pinned for hydration.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the cycle and labels the ring.

usageNotes: The outgoings are real checkboxes inside a labelled list: Tab reaches each one, Space toggles it, and each row's accessible name carries the amount and the day it lands.
Under reduced motion the arc still fills and the markers still appear — on a tween, with the projection setting instead of counting — because a countdown is information.
Nothing runs on a timer and nothing reads the clock: the day count arrives as a prop, so the ring renders identically on the server and the client.

items.title: Currency Stack
items.tagline: Every currency in its own lane.
items.description: A stack where every currency keeps its own lane and its own units. Choosing a lane sends it to the top and the rest close the gap beneath it — a layout reorder on glide, so each lane travels rather than the list redrawing — and the chosen lane opens a conversion strip whose converted total rolls its digits on snap under a rate readout. A new rate table pulses the strip with a cobalt wash on the exit ease; Up and Down walk the lanes, Home and End jump, Enter or Space brings the focused lane to the top.

props.name: balances
props.description: One lane per currency — code, name and amount — in their resting order.

props.name: rates
props.description: Units of `display` per one unit of each code; handing down a new table pulses the strip.

props.name: display
props.description: The code every lane converts into.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial selected code — the lane on top.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed lanes.

props.name: format
props.description: Renders every balance and the converted total.

props.name: formatRate
props.description: Renders the rate in the readout.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the wallet and labels the stack.

usageNotes: A listbox with manual selection: one Tab stop, Up and Down walk the lanes in the order they are drawn, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space brings the focused lane to the top. Arrows move focus without selecting, because selecting reorders the list.
Under reduced motion the lanes swap position without travel, the strip opens on a tween and the digits set in place — the order and the converted total still change, because both are the information.

The strip's height is animated from its own content rather than reserved, so a closed lane costs exactly one row; a visually hidden status announces one settled sentence per change, never one per digit.

items.title: Balance Mask
items.tagline: Hidden by default, shown on purpose.
items.description: A balance drawn as bullets until you hold it: the two layers share one grid cell and clip against each other, so holding drives the boundary across on glide and releasing runs it back on the exit ease, with the mono face keeping both strings exactly the same width. Space or Enter toggles instead of holding and cross-fades rather than wipes — no travel where there was no gesture — while Escape hides and a released pointer anywhere on the page re-masks the figure. The eye's slash draws on flick.

props.name: amount
props.description: The figure behind the mask.

props.name: label
props.description: What the figure is; sits above it and names the control.

props.name: format
props.description: Renders the figure; the mask is built from its output, so only digits become bullets.

props.name: revealed / defaultRevealed
props.description: Controlled or initial reveal, for a page-wide hide-balances switch.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer, key or blur that changed it.

props.name: holdToReveal
props.description: False makes the pointer toggle, and fade, instead of hold.

props.name: maskChar
props.description: The character every digit becomes.

props.name: hint
props.description: One short line under the figure; dims while the figure is shown.

usageNotes: Keyboard: Space or Enter toggles the reveal and cross-fades it, Escape hides, and a held key cannot flutter the mask because the repeat is ignored. Blurring while holding re-masks.
Under reduced motion every path is a fade — the balance still shows and still hides, because that is the whole control.

The figure is in the DOM behind the mask: this is a shoulder-surfing guard, not a security boundary. Nothing captures the pointer, so a stray drag across the control cannot leave the balance standing open.

items.title: Send Flow
items.tagline: Who, how much, then the one press that matters.
items.description: Three steps for one payment. Panels cross-slide by direction on glide inside a card whose height is measured by a ResizeObserver, so no step is padded out to the tallest; on the review step the amount lands on recoil and the confirm button is inert until that landing completes. Recipients are a radio group with a roving tabindex where arrows step, Home and End jump and Space chooses.

props.name: recipients
props.description: Who can be paid: id, name, handle and tint. Faces are drawn from initials — no images.

props.name: step / defaultStep
props.description: Controlled or initial step.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that moved the step.

props.name: recipientId / defaultRecipientId
props.description: Controlled or initial payee; empty means nothing is chosen and Next is refused.

props.name: amount / defaultAmount
props.description: Controlled or initial amount in major units.

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick amounts offered under the field.

props.name: balance
props.description: Ceiling for the amount; over it the flow refuses to go on and says why.

props.name: format
props.description: Money formatter — the flow never invents a currency. Defaults to an en-US Intl.NumberFormat so server and client agree.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Fires from the confirm press, once the figure has landed.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the card for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Payees are a radio group with a roving tabindex: arrows step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Space chooses. Back and Next are real buttons sharing one row.
The confirm button stays inert until the review figure finishes landing, and says so through aria-describedby rather than disappearing.
Under reduced motion panels cross-fade in place, the figure fades, and the button arms on that tween — the height still animates, because a card collapsing is information.

items.title: Recipient Pick
items.tagline: Faces first, then the rest of the name.
items.description: Recent payees drawn as faces. Picking one grows its row item into a chip carrying the full name and handle beside the same disc — a layout animation on glide — while the others shrink and recede on a tween. Typing filters the row and the survivors travel to their new slots through the same FLIP; the row is a listbox where arrows step, Home and End jump, Enter chooses and Escape returns to the field.

props.name: people
props.description: The recent payees: id, name, handle and tint. Pass a theme token as the tint so both themes read.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial payee id; null is the unpicked row.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that chose or cleared.

props.name: query / defaultQuery
props.description: Controlled or initial filter text.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires from the field's input event.

props.name: max
props.description: Faces drawn before the row stops; the count line says how many matched.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible field label and the row's group name.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Field placeholder.

usageNotes: The row is a listbox with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump, Enter and Space choose or clear, Escape hands focus back to the field. Down from the field enters the row at the chosen face.
Faces are procedural — initials on a disc tinted from the token you pass — so the row costs no image requests.
Under reduced motion the chip swaps in, the row re-lays instantly and the unchosen faces dim by opacity alone.

items.title: Amount Pad
items.tagline: Digits you can feel land.
items.description: A keypad for money whose figure is the instrument. A pressed key sinks on flick, and each new character slides into the figure from its right on snap, keyed by role so only the typed digit mounts. The decimal point draws a rule under the cents and holds their width; a press that would pass the limit is refused rather than clamped, jumping the figure so recoil can ring it back.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial amount in major units.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the key press or keystroke that changed the amount.

props.name: limit
props.description: Ceiling; a press that would pass it is refused and shakes the figure. Omit for no ceiling.

props.name: onLimitReached
props.description: Fires from the refused press, with the amount that was attempted.

props.name: format
props.description: Prints the figure; fractionDigits is how many cents digits have been typed, so the field is not padded to .00 before the payer gets there. Defaults to an en-US Intl.NumberFormat.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the pad and the readout.

props.name: caption
props.description: A quiet line under the figure — what the money is for. Falls back to the limit.

usageNotes: One group over a three-column key grid with a roving tabindex: arrows walk the keys, Home and End jump, Enter and Space press. Digits, a point and Backspace typed inside the pad drive the same actions.
Keys that can no longer act — digits once both cents are typed, the point once it is placed — carry aria-disabled and stay focusable, so the keyboard can still read the whole pad.
Under reduced motion nothing sinks, slides or shakes: the key takes a fill, the digits appear, and a refusal still turns the figure and raises its line.

items.title: Transfer Track
items.tagline: Sent, on its way, landed.
items.description: Three stops and one payment moving between them. The dot glides from stop to stop on glide and the rail fills to the same point on the same spring, placed from a measured track width so it lands true at any column width. Reaching a stop stamps its time on recoil; a failed hop turns the segment ahead danger under a hatch, holds the dot, and offers a Retry the keyboard can reach.

props.name: stops
props.description: The three stops, in order.

props.name: reached
props.description: Index of the furthest stop actually reached, 0 to 2.

props.name: stamps
props.description: Formatted times per stop; a new entry stamps in. The card never reads a clock itself.

props.name: failed
props.description: The hop out of `reached` failed: the segment ahead turns danger and Retry appears.

props.name: failureMessage
props.description: The line shown beside Retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fires from the Retry press. Omit it and no Retry is offered.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum in flight, printed in the header.

props.name: format
props.description: Money formatter — the card never invents a currency. Defaults to an en-US Intl.NumberFormat.

props.name: label
props.description: What the transfer is; names the region.

props.name: reference
props.description: A quiet mono line under the header — the reference the host issued.

usageNotes: The stops are an ordered list carrying aria-current="step" and a hidden state word each, so the run never reads by colour or position alone; the failure is a role="alert" beside a real Retry button.
Times are formatted strings from the host, stamped when they first arrive — stops already stamped at mount render settled rather than stamping at a viewer who watched nothing.
Under reduced motion the dot jumps and the fill runs on a tween, and stamps appear without landing — progress is still fully shown.

items.title: Split Bill
items.tagline: Everyone's share, nobody's argument.
items.description: One bill across several faces with a total that cannot drift. Dragging a row's track reshapes every other share in proportion so they always sum to one, and the rows that moved follow on glide while the track under the finger stays unsprung. Equalise snaps every share even on snap through a cascade; each track is a real slider whose arrows, Page keys and Home and End reshape the others exactly as a drag does.

props.name: total
props.description: The bill in major units.

props.name: people
props.description: Who is splitting it: id, name and tint. Faces are initials on a disc — no images.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial shares as fractions in `people` order; normalised to sum to 1.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag, the key, or Equalise — never from a render.

props.name: format
props.description: Money formatter — the card never invents a currency. Defaults to an en-US Intl.NumberFormat.

props.name: step
props.description: Share a single arrow key moves; Page Up and Page Down move five of them.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the card for assistive technology.

props.name: caption
props.description: A quiet line under the header — the venue and the date.

usageNotes: Every track is a role="slider" named for its person and voiced as money as well as a percentage: arrows move by step, Page Up and Page Down by five, Home and End go to nothing and everything.
The pointer is captured only after 4px of travel, so a plain tap still sets the share it landed on and a synthetic sweep through the card cannot throw.

Shares are rounded to the cent with the remainder handed to the largest, so the printed shares always add up to the printed total; under reduced motion the fills move on a short tween and the equalise cascade goes.

items.title: Schedule Send
items.tagline: Now, later, or every month.
items.description: A two-stop control decides when the money leaves, one knob travelling between Now and Scheduled on snap. Choosing Scheduled unfolds a date spinbutton and a repeat picker whose height is measured rather than reserved, gliding open on glide and closing to a true zero, while the summary sentence rewrites itself token by token — only the words that changed leave and arrive. Both pickers are radiogroups with a roving tabindex where arrows step and Home and End jump; the date takes arrows for a day and Page keys for a week.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial schedule: mode, days after baseDate, repeat.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the control that changed, never from render.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum being scheduled; drives the summary sentence.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount the component prints.

props.name: baseDate
props.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD the offset counts from, read in UTC so no clock is sampled during render.

props.name: maxOffsetDays
props.description: Furthest schedulable day.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group label and the mode radiogroup's accessible name.

usageNotes: Two radiogroups with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Space selects. The date is a spinbutton — arrows move a day, PageUp and PageDown move a week, Home returns to tomorrow, End jumps to the last schedulable day.
The panel's height is measured with a ResizeObserver and closes to zero, so nothing reserves room for a picker nobody opened.
Under reduced motion the knobs swap instantly, the panel opens without a spring, and the summary tokens cross-fade in place — the sentence still rewrites.

items.title: Transfer Receipt
items.tagline: The receipt prints itself.
items.description: A send unrolls the sheet from a true zero to the height a ResizeObserver measured, on glide, with overflow-hidden clipping it so the lines emerge from under the top edge in a cascade rather than fading in place. Once the last line lands the reference types itself in, one character per tick, pausing while the tab is hidden; pressing it copies the reference and the glyph draws a check on flick. The lines are a real description list, the reference is a button one Tab away, and a single polite live region announces the receipt on settle rather than per character.

props.name: open
props.description: Raise it once the send has gone through; the sheet unrolls.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum sent, printed at the head of the sheet.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the head figure and every line carrying an amount.

props.name: lines
props.description: Label and value pairs printed in order; a line's amount is routed through format.

props.name: reference
props.description: The reference number that types itself in and is copied on press.

props.name: title
props.description: Sheet heading and the section's accessible name.

props.name: typeSpeedMs
props.description: Milliseconds per typed character; 0 prints the reference at once.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Fires from the copy press with whether the clipboard accepted it.

usageNotes: The reference is a real button: Tab reaches it, Enter or Space copies, and the outcome is announced by the receipt's live region rather than by colour.
The typing interval lives in an effect with cleanup and skips ticks while the document is hidden, so a backgrounded tab never prints to nobody.
Under reduced motion the sheet opens without a spring, the lines arrive with opacity only, and the reference is printed whole from the first frame.

items.title: Limit Meter
items.tagline: How much room today has left.
items.description: The fill is made of the actual sends rather than anonymous ticks: each transfer is its own block, its width its share of the limit, growing from zero on glide and shrinking away on the exit ease when it is cancelled. Ahead of the fill the staged amount previews as a hatched segment that arrives on snap and marches one seamless stripe period while it stands, stopping when the tab is hidden. Crossing the limit turns the preview and the rail danger and prints the overage in money, and the remaining figure rolls to its new value on glide.

props.name: entries
props.description: Sends already counted against today, oldest first; each is one block of the fill.

props.name: limit
props.description: The daily ceiling; the full width of the rail.

props.name: pending
props.description: The amount about to be sent, drawn as the hatched preview.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount the meter prints.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the meter for assistive technology.

props.name: resetNote
props.description: Small note under the rail — the window's own words.

usageNotes: A role="meter" whose aria-valuenow stays inside the limit, with aria-valuetext naming the total, the staged amount and any overage in words — the over state is never colour alone.
Nothing here takes focus: it is a readout, driven entirely by its props.
Under reduced motion the widths are set without springs and the hatch stands still — the fill still fills, because how much room is left is information.

items.title: Confirm Slab
items.tagline: Read it before you press it.
items.description: The facts reveal one after another on a cascade — amount, recipient, fee, total — each rising on glide so the eye is walked down the card in the order the numbers matter. The confirm control is a track with a detent: the thumb follows the pointer to a drawn notch at 62%, meets resistance past it, and parks there when released, then slams home on flick once it is pushed through; released short of the notch it springs back on snap. Confirming sinks the slab on the exit ease and collapses its space on glide to one confirmed line with a tick drawn on flick.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum being confirmed; the card's headline figure.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount, the fee, and the total.

props.name: recipient
props.description: Who is being paid; truncates with a title.

props.name: account
props.description: The masked account line under the recipient.

props.name: fee
props.description: Added to the amount for the total row.

props.name: note
props.description: Optional last row — what the transfer is for.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Track copy while idle, and the slider's accessible name.

props.name: sentLabel
props.description: Copy for the line the slab collapses to.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the track and dims the slab.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Fires once, from the gesture or key that landed the slide.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fires from the Cancel button.

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: Fires as the control moves between its stages.

usageNotes: The track is a role="slider": ArrowRight and ArrowUp move to the detent and then past it, ArrowLeft and ArrowDown return it to the start, Home and Escape reset it, End runs it home, and Enter or Space confirms from the detent.
Pointer capture is taken only after 4px of travel and inside a try/catch, so a plain click is never swallowed and a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
Under reduced motion the rows fade without travel, the thumb is set rather than sprung, and the sink becomes a fade — the confirmed line and its tick still appear.

items.title: Settle Pulse
items.tagline: Pending until the network says so.
items.description: Waiting, the pill breathes: it scales between two keyframes on drift with repeatType mirror while a halo swells in opposition behind it, and the breath rests while the tab is hidden. When the status settles the breathing returns to rest on drift and the pill widens on snap to the measured width its new word and settled sum need, clipping them so they are revealed as the surface arrives. The tick then stamps on recoil with the check drawing on flick; a returned transfer takes the same widening and no bounce, because a failure never celebrates.

props.name: status
props.description: Which state the pill shows; changing it runs the settle.

props.name: amount
props.description: Optional sum; it joins the pill once the network settles or returns it, which is what the pill widens to fit.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides the word for any state.

props.name: network
props.description: Who has to say so — printed under the pill and named in the announcement.

props.name: size
props.description: Pill height: h-7 or h-9, so it keeps the row height it sits in.

props.name: onSettled
props.description: Fires once the stamp has landed, from the animation's own completion.

usageNotes: A polite role="status" carrying a whole sentence for assistive technology, so the state is never colour or pulse alone. It is a readout with no interactive parts, so it never takes focus.
The pill's width is measured from its content with a ResizeObserver rather than guessed, so a longer word widens it exactly.
Under reduced motion there is no breath and no halo, the widening is instant, and the tick appears already drawn.

items.title: Card Face
items.tagline: A card that turns to show its back.
items.description: A payment card whose reveal switch turns the whole slab on snap — a real rotateY with both faces backface-hidden — so the back arrives with one crisp overshoot. The full number un-masks digit by digit as the turn lands, a cascade of flicks that runs backwards when the card closes, and freezing settles a frost veneer on a tween that turns the card home and locks the switch. The control is a role="switch" button, so Space and Enter turn the card.

props.name: number
props.description: Card number; non-digits are stripped and the rest padded to sixteen.

props.name: revealed / defaultRevealed
props.description: Controlled or initial reveal state.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Fires from the click on the reveal switch.

props.name: frozen
props.description: Frosts the face, hides the details and locks the switch.

props.name: holder
props.description: Name printed on both faces.

props.name: expiry
props.description: Expiry exactly as printed.

props.name: securityCode
props.description: Three or four digits on the signature panel.

props.name: network
props.description: Network wordmark on the front.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the card group for assistive technology.

props.name: revealLabel
props.description: Reveal switch copy.

usageNotes: The reveal control is a real role="switch" button: Tab to it, Space or Enter turns the card. The face turned away is aria-hidden and the number carries its own aria-label, so a reader hears one number, not sixteen columns.
Under reduced motion the faces cross-fade in place and every digit un-masks at once — no rotation, no stagger — because which digits are showing is information.
Freezing hides the details for as long as it lasts; clear `revealed` as well if a controlled card should stay shut after it thaws.

items.title: Card Freeze
items.tagline: Frozen in a swipe.
items.description: A throw switch that freezes a card: the knob tracks the pointer once the drag clears 4px and commits past the halfway mark on snap, springing home on the same spring when it is released short. Behind it a seeded field of crystals sits under a radial-gradient mask whose hole radius is a motion value, so freezing spreads the frost inward from the edges on drift and thawing lets it recede from the centre. The track is a role="switch": Space and Enter toggle, Right freezes, Left thaws, Escape abandons a throw.

props.name: frozen / defaultFrozen
props.description: Controlled or initial frozen state.

props.name: onFrozenChange
props.description: Fires from the release, click or key that committed the throw.

props.name: onProgressChange
props.description: Whole-percent throw position, for a status line that narrates the gesture.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the switch.

props.name: network
props.description: Network wordmark on the slab.

props.name: last4
props.description: Last four digits printed on the slab.

props.name: holder
props.description: Name on the slab.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the crystal pattern — the same seed always draws the same frost.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the track.

usageNotes: The track is a role="switch" with a roving focus: Space and Enter toggle it, ArrowRight and End freeze, ArrowLeft and Home thaw, Escape settles a throw already in progress back where it started.
Under reduced motion the knob jumps to its end and the veneer cross-fades in place instead of spreading — the frost still arrives, because whether the card is frozen is information.
The crystal field is procedural and seeded, so it renders identically on the server and the client and needs no assets.

items.title: Virtual Mint
items.tagline: A new card, minted in front of you.
items.description: Press to mint a virtual card: a blank slab rises on recoil, ζ0.53, the two bounces of a thing landing on the bench, and then its number prints in a cascade of flicks before the expiry and the name follow. The slab files itself away on the exit ease while the wallet row makes room on glide and the new chip lands. One phase machine drives it from a single timer chain that stops while the document is hidden, and every number is seeded rather than random.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds every minted number and expiry — the same press mints the same card.

props.name: defaultCards
props.description: Cards already in the wallet row; omit it and one is seeded for you.

props.name: maxCards
props.description: Wallet cap; the oldest chip leaves when it is passed.

props.name: holder
props.description: Name printed on each card.

props.name: network
props.description: Network wordmark on the slab.

props.name: onMint
props.description: Fires from the filing timer, once the card has landed in the wallet.

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Fires from the click and from each phase timer: idle, rising, printing, filing.

props.name: mintLabel
props.description: Mint button copy.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the wallet row.

usageNotes: The mint control is a real button, disabled and aria-busy while a mint is in flight; the wallet is a list whose scroller takes focus, so a keyboard can pan it.
Under reduced motion nothing rises, slides or shrinks: the slab appears at rest, the three fields print at once, and the chip lands in place — the card is still minted.
The phase chain stops while the document is hidden and restarts the phase it was in, so a mint never completes on a tab nobody is watching.

items.title: Spend Limit
items.tagline: Drag the ceiling, watch the room.
items.description: A card's monthly limit as a rail you drag over a column of the spend so far. The column fills on glide with no overshoot, the rail tracks the pointer once the drag clears 4px and settles onto the nearest step on snap, and the remaining-room chip rides the rail with its figure rolling on the same spring. Dragging the ceiling under the spend hatches the slice above it in danger on a colour tween — nothing bounces. It is a vertical role="slider": arrows step, Page keys move five, Home and End run to the ends.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial limit.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer move or key that changed the ceiling.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Fires once the ceiling has settled — on release, or on key-up.

props.name: spend
props.description: Spend so far, drawn as the column fill.

props.name: max
props.description: Top of the scale.

props.name: step
props.description: Release snap and arrow step; Page keys move five of them.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount in the instrument.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the slider.

props.name: unit
props.description: Suffix beside the headline figure.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the rail.

usageNotes: A vertical role="slider": ArrowUp and ArrowRight add a step, ArrowDown and ArrowLeft take one, PageUp and PageDown move five, Home and End run to the ends, and aria-valuetext says the money and the room in words.
Under reduced motion the rail and the fill move without a spring, but the colours, the hatch and the figures still change — where the ceiling stands is information.
Every amount, including the rolling room figure, goes through `format`, and the digits are tabular so a roll never shifts the layout.

items.title: Card PIN
items.tagline: Four digits, shown one at a time.
items.description: A PIN reveal you have to hold. Each cell is a two-face column that rolls its bullet away for its digit on snap, staggered by cascade so the four land one at a time, and rolls back in reverse when you let go. A ring inside the control drains linearly across the window from a motion value, ending the reveal on its own when it empties. Space held reveals while held, Enter latches the reveal for the whole window, and Escape closes it.

props.name: pin
props.description: Digits to reveal; non-digits are stripped.

props.name: holdFor
props.description: Milliseconds the reveal may stay open before the ring closes it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group.

props.name: holdLabel
props.description: Control copy while the PIN is hidden.

props.name: shownLabel
props.description: Control copy while the PIN is showing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the control.

props.name: onRevealChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer, key or timeout that changed the reveal.

props.name: onTimeout
props.description: Fires from the ring's completion, when the window runs out.

usageNotes: Two keyboard paths, because not everyone can hold a key: Space held shows the PIN while held, Enter latches it for the whole window, and Enter again or Escape closes it early.
Under reduced motion the columns swap face instantly instead of rolling, but they still swap and the ring still drains at the same linear rate — both are information.
Hiding the document ends the reveal outright, so a PIN never sits uncovered on a tab nobody is watching.

items.title: Card Tap
items.tagline: Tap to pay, watched.
items.description: A contactless payment drawn as a scene: push the slab toward the reader and past six tenths of its travel the tap fires, the card closing the gap on snap while rings pulse from the contact point on drift for as long as the read lasts. Approval stamps a tick on recoil; a decline never celebrates, shaking the card home on a tween instead. The slab is a real button, so Enter, Space and Right Arrow tap it without a pointer.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial phase of the tap.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the gesture or key that moved the card to the reader.

props.name: onTap
props.description: Fires once the card reaches the reader — start the authorisation here.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum being tapped.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount; the stage never invents a currency.

props.name: merchant
props.description: Who is being paid.

props.name: network
props.description: Network wordmark printed on the slab.

props.name: last4
props.description: Last four digits printed on the slab.

props.name: declineReason
props.description: Printed under the stage when the tap is refused.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The slab is a real button named for the card, the sum and the merchant: Enter, Space and Right Arrow all tap, so the drag has a full keyboard path. One sr-only role="status" carries the outcome, so a reader hears it once rather than twice.
Under reduced motion nothing travels — the reader lights, the tick appears at full size and a decline holds a static danger mark — because the outcome of a payment is information, not flourish.
The travel is read from the track and the slab inside the pointer and key handlers, never during render, so the scene follows its container at any width.

items.title: Card Order
items.tagline: From the press to your door.
items.description: A card on its way to you: a miniature slab rides a rail above the stops and slides to the one the order has reached on glide, landing on recoil at the last stop where a tick stamps into the final dot. The rail fills behind it and each reached dot flicks in on a cascade, so a jump of two stages lights in sequence. Under the rail the day count rolls on snap and the date cross-fades.

props.name: stage
props.description: Index of the furthest stop reached; clamped to the stage list.

props.name: stages
props.defaultValue: printed / posted / out for delivery / delivered
props.description: The stops in order; each carries an id, a label and a short note.

props.name: etaDays
props.description: Days until arrival; the digits roll when the estimate tightens.

props.name: etaDate
props.description: The date under the count; cross-fades when it changes.

props.name: deliveredNote
props.description: Replaces the estimate once the last stop is reached.

props.name: network
props.description: Wordmark printed beside the order reference.

props.name: last4
props.description: Last four digits of the card on its way.

props.name: fee
props.description: Replacement fee; zero prints "No fee".

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the fee; the order never invents a currency.

props.name: reference
props.description: Order reference, printed mono and selectable.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A read-only tracker: the stops are an ordered list, the furthest reached carries aria-current="step", each stop spells done or waiting for a reader, and one sr-only role="status" announces the change in a sentence.
Under reduced motion the slab swaps to its stop instantly and the dots simply appear, but the rail still fills and the count still rolls over, because how far a parcel has come is information.
The slab is exactly one column wide, so a stage of travel is exactly one of its own widths — the stop and its dot cannot drift apart at any container width.

items.title: Merchant Lock
items.tagline: Only where you say.
items.description: A card's spending rules, one row per merchant category. Locking a row closes the hasp on flick, dims the row on a colour tween and strikes its amount, so the state is carried by shape and text rather than tone alone; the allowed figure below sums every open category and rolls its digits to the new total on snap. The header control sweeps every row at once, staggered by cascade so a wall of locks closes in sequence.

props.name: categories
props.description: The rows to draw: id, label, amount and an optional drawn glyph.

props.name: locked / defaultLocked
props.description: Controlled or initial ids of the locked categories.

props.name: onLockedChange
props.type: (locked: string[], changed: { id: string; locked: boolean }) => void
props.description: Fires from the click or key that toggled a lock; the id is "*" for the header sweep.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount; the list never invents a currency.

props.name: period
props.description: Suffix on the row amounts and on the total.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading, also the list's accessible name.

props.name: showLockAll
props.description: Renders the header control that locks or opens every row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the rules themselves; every switch goes inert.

usageNotes: Each padlock is a real role="switch" button named by its row, so Tab reaches every one and Space toggles it; the header control states what it will do rather than what it is.
Locked rows keep full contrast on the name — only the amount dims and strikes — so nothing becomes unreadable when it is switched off, and the state never rests on colour alone.
Under reduced motion the hasp is drawn already closed or open, the total swaps in place and the sweep applies to every row at once with no stagger.

items.title: Card Stack
items.tagline: Your cards, in a fanned stack.
items.description: A wallet whose cards shingle down the stage with the strip that names each one left showing. Hovering the stack, or moving focus into it, fans it on glide; picking a card brings it to the front on snap and the others tuck behind in the order they were in, so working through the wallet reads as rotation rather than a reshuffle. It is a radio group: arrows cycle the front card, Home and End jump to the ends.

props.name: cards
props.description: The wallet, front first: id, name, last4 and an optional network and balance. The first five are used.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial id of the front card.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that brought a card forward.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every balance; the wallet never invents a currency.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Forces the fan open; leave it out and hover or focus opens it.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading, also the group's accessible name.

usageNotes: A radio group with a roving tabindex, so the wallet is one Tab stop: Down and Right take the next card to the front, Up and Left the previous, Home and End the ends, Space and Enter pick the focused one.
Under reduced motion the fan stays open from the first paint and picking swaps the order instantly — which card leads is still plain from its ring and its weight.
Every offset is a percentage of a card's own height and the stage's height a percentage of its own width, so the instrument scales with its column and reserves nothing.

items.title: Chip Contact
items.tagline: The chip lights when it reads.
items.description: A close-up of a card's contact plate while a reader talks to it: a glint sweeps the plate on a linear tween as the eight pads light one after another in a cascade of flicks, then the read fills the plate left to right, determinate when the host passes progress and sweeping when it does not. Success stamps a disc on recoil with its tick drawn by pathLength; a refusal blinks the plate twice on a tween and offers Retry.

props.name: status
props.description: The phase the reader is in.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–1. Given, the scan is determinate and reported; omitted, it loops.

props.name: steps
props.description: Read steps; the line under the plate names the one progress has reached.

props.name: reader
props.description: Who is reading, printed in the header.

props.name: declineReason
props.description: Printed under the plinth when the read is refused.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fires from the Retry press; omit it and no Retry is offered.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology.

usageNotes: The plate is a role="progressbar": with progress it reports a value and an aria-valuetext naming the step, and without one it is simply aria-busy, which is what indeterminate means. Retry is a real button, so it takes Space and Enter natively.
Under reduced motion there is no glint, no travelling bar and no blink, but the pads still light, the fill still fills and the tick still appears — how far a read has got is information.
The read itself belongs to the host: drive progress from a timer that clears on unmount and stops while the document is hidden, as the demo does.

items.title: Order Book
items.tagline: Bids and asks, meeting in the middle.
items.description: A two-sided price ladder where asks stack above the spread band and bids below, each row laid over a depth bar scaled to the deeper side so the halves stay comparable. A new price level slides in from the ladder's outer edge on snap while a filled level drains toward the touch on glide and an emptied one collapses out on the exit ease; the spread band breathes on a slow mirrored tween that stops while the document is hidden. It is a real grid: a roving tabindex puts ArrowUp and ArrowDown through every rung across the spread, Home and End jump to the ends, and each row speaks the cumulative depth the hover reading shows.

props.name: bids
props.description: Buy levels, best (highest) first.

props.name: asks
props.description: Sell levels, best (lowest) first.

props.name: depth
props.description: Rows drawn per side; deeper levels fall off the ladder.

props.name: symbol
props.description: The pair the ladder is for; names the grid for assistive technology.

props.name: sizeUnit
props.description: Unit printed after sizes and spoken in row labels.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns money into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: formatSize
props.description: Turns a size into its printed string.

props.name: onLevelRead
props.description: Fires from the pointer or focus event that changed the read level, with the side, price, size and cumulative depth, and with null when the pointer leaves.

usageNotes: A roving tabindex over rows: ArrowUp and ArrowDown walk the whole ladder across the spread band, Home and End jump to the far ask and the far bid, and the focused row reports the same reading a hover does.
Under reduced motion levels appear and resize in place with no slide or drain, and the spread band stops breathing — the depths, the reading and the totals all still show.
The band's breathing tween is torn down whenever the document is hidden, so a backgrounded tab animates nothing.

items.title: Price Ticker
items.tagline: Each print, in the direction it moved.
items.description: A price whose digit columns roll one face on snap in the direction the print moved — up from below when it rose, down from above when it fell — while columns that did not change hold still. A wash flashes success or danger behind the figure and leaves on the exit ease, and the change chip rolls its sign and percent on the same pair while its arrow turns over on snap. The component never generates a print: it rolls what it is given, reports each committed one through onPrint, and writes a polite sr-only sentence only after the flash window is quiet, so a burst of prints announces once.

props.name: price
props.description: The last price. Changing it rolls the digits the way the print moved and flashes the wash.

props.name: previousClose
props.description: The basis the change chip is measured against.

props.name: symbol
props.description: The instrument printed above the figure; names the readout for assistive technology.

props.name: venue
props.description: A quiet line beside the symbol — the book the print came from.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns a price into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: flashMs
props.description: How long the direction wash holds before it fades, and the quiet the live region waits out before it announces.

props.name: size
props.description: Figure scale; md fits the price into a dense row.

props.name: onPrint
props.description: Fires once per committed print, from the effect that observed it.

usageNotes: Not a control: the figure takes no focus and steals none. A single polite sr-only sentence carries the price, the direction in words and the percent, written once the flash window has been quiet so a fast tape announces once rather than per print.
Under reduced motion the faces swap with no travel and the arrow swaps instead of turning, while the direction wash still appears and fades — which way the price moved is information, not flourish.
The component generates nothing itself; drive price from a stream, a poll or a button and it rolls what it is handed.

items.title: Order Ticket
items.tagline: Buy or sell, sized by a slider.
items.description: An order ticket whose side toggle carries one knob across the card on glide — a layout-scale move rather than a switch flipping in place — while a size slider tracks the pointer one to one and is drawn to the nearest detent on snap, the only overshoot in the ticket. The estimated cost rolls its digits on the same spring, and submitting is a track: the thumb lands on flick past 85 percent of the travel and springs back on snap when it is released short. The side takes Left and Right, the slider takes Arrows and PageUp/PageDown for the next detent, and the track takes ArrowRight, End and then Enter.

props.name: symbol
props.description: The instrument the ticket is for.

props.name: price
props.description: The working price the estimate is built from.

props.name: buyingPower
props.description: What 100 percent on the size slider is worth.

props.name: side / defaultSide
props.description: Controlled or initial side; the knob glides between the two stops.

props.name: onSideChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed the side.

props.name: sizePercent / defaultSizePercent
props.description: Controlled or initial size as a percentage of buying power.

props.name: onSizePercentChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that moved the slider, and from the detent settle.

props.name: detents
props.description: Percentages the thumb is drawn to; also the quick-size buttons under the track.

props.name: snapWithin
props.description: How near a detent a release must land, in percent, to be pulled in.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns money into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Unit for the estimated quantity.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Fires once from the gesture or key that completed the submit track, with the side, percent, amount and units.

props.name: submittedFor
props.description: Milliseconds the track holds its sent state before re-arming; 0 holds it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the toggle, the slider and the track.

usageNotes: Three keyboard contracts in one card: the side is a radio group on Left and Right, the size slider takes Arrows for one percent with PageUp and PageDown jumping to the next detent and Home and End for the ends, and the submit track takes ArrowRight or End to slide and Enter at the top to send.
Under reduced motion the knob swaps between stops, both thumbs move without physics and the cost swaps its digits — where a gesture got to is still drawn, because that is information.
Pointer capture is taken only after 4px of travel and always inside a try/catch, so a plain click is never swallowed and a synthetic drag through the ticket cannot throw.

items.title: Fill Tape
items.tagline: Trades as they happen.
items.description: Time and sales printed downward: the newest fill mounts at the foot of the tape from a step below on snap while the rows above glide up a line, and at capacity the top row collapses out on the exit ease as the column, measured by a ResizeObserver, settles to its new height. Holding is honest rather than cosmetic — hover, focus or the Hold button freezes the rows you were reading and counts arrivals into a waiting chip instead of dropping them, and the session volume freezes with them and rolls up through the whole backlog on release. Rows are list items whose labels speak the side in words, and Hold is a real aria-pressed button reachable by Tab.

props.name: fills
props.description: The tape, oldest first. `time` is already printed by the producer, so no clock is read here.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Rows kept on screen; older ones collapse off the top.

props.name: symbol
props.description: The pair the tape is for; names the list for assistive technology.

props.name: sizeUnit
props.description: Unit printed after sizes and spoken in row labels.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns money into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: formatSize
props.description: Turns a size into its printed string.

props.name: held / defaultHeld
props.description: Controlled or initial latch on the Hold control; hover and focus hold transiently on top of it.

props.name: onHeldChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that toggled the latch.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Fires from the effect that observed the effective hold — latch, hover or focus — and again as the backlog grows.

props.name: onVolumeSettle
props.description: Fires from the effect that observed the printed volume change, never during render.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The line the tape shows before its first print.

usageNotes: Hold is the keyboard equivalent of the hover hold: Tab to it and press Enter or Space to latch. Tabbing to it already holds the tape, because the card holds on focus-within, so reaching the control never costs you the rows you were reading.

Under reduced motion rows appear and leave without travel or a layout glide, but the tape still advances and the volume still updates — a tape that stopped saying what traded would be broken, not calm.
The component prints only what it is given: it never mints a fill and never reads a clock, so the producer owns the stream, its cleanup and its printed times.

items.title: Candle Brush
items.tagline: Draw a range; read the move.
items.description: A candlestick chart you can draw on. Each candle grows out of its own open — the body scales from nothing with its transform origin pinned to the open edge, so an up bar rises and a down bar drops — on glide in a cascade that keeps the whole chart inside the choreography budget. Pressing drops a brush anchor and dragging sweeps a range whose edges snap to whole candles on snap while everything outside dims on a tween and the readout gives the open, close and percent; the crosshair snaps to the bar under the pointer on flick rather than riding free. Arrows walk the crosshair, Space drops the anchor, Shift with an arrow extends the range and Escape clears it.

props.name: candles
props.description: Bars, oldest first: id, label, open, high, low and close. The label is printed by the caller, so no clock is read here.

props.name: symbol
props.description: The instrument; names the plot for assistive technology.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. The width is fluid and measured with a ResizeObserver.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns a price into its printed string. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: selection / defaultSelection
props.description: Controlled or initial brushed range, as inclusive candle indices.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that changed the range, never during render.

props.name: onCursorChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that moved the crosshair.

usageNotes: One focusable plot with a complete keyboard equivalent of the drag: Arrows walk the crosshair a bar at a time, Home and End jump to the ends, Space drops or lifts the brush anchor, Shift with an arrow extends the range, and Escape clears it. A polite region reads the cursor bar's full OHLC.

Under reduced motion the candles render already drawn, the crosshair jumps and the band moves without a spring — the dimming, the lit range and the readout all still work, because what is selected is the point of the instrument.
A tap sets the crosshair and lifts the brush rather than leaving an empty range behind; capture is taken only after 4px of travel, inside a try/catch.

items.title: Position Card
items.tagline: Profit that moves as the price does.
items.description: An open position that keeps score. The unrealised P&L rolls its digits on snap with each print while a tint washes behind the figure in the direction of the move, and a scaled bar under it runs from a fixed zero anchor — profit right toward the target tick, loss left down a shorter lane at the same dollars per pixel — both on glide. Closing is a slide whose knob rides a motion value, and the rail is a slider: arrows step, Home releases, End crosses the detent.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Instrument code shown in the header.

props.name: side
props.description: Which way the position profits.

props.name: size
props.description: Units held; scales every money figure.

props.name: entry
props.description: Average entry price.

props.name: price
props.description: Mark price. A new value rolls the P&L and flashes the print.

props.name: target
props.description: Take-profit price — the far end of the gain lane.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every money figure.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats prices.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Noun printed after the size.

props.name: zeroAt
props.description: Share of the track left of zero — the loss lane.

props.name: closed / defaultClosed
props.description: Controlled or initial closed state.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires from the gesture or key that crossed the detent.

props.name: onSlideProgress
props.description: 0–1, fired from the pointer or key that moved the knob.

usageNotes: The close rail is a slider: Right and Up step forward, Left and Down back, Home releases it, End crosses the detent, and Enter or Space closes from past halfway.
Pointer capture is taken only after 4px of travel and inside try/catch, so a plain tap still lands and a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
Under reduced motion the digits swap instead of rolling and the knob jumps between stops, but the bar still fills and the print still tints — progress is information.

items.title: Stop Rail
items.tagline: Drag your stop; the risk redraws.
items.description: A trade plan you can grab. Stop, entry and target handles ride one price rail and the bands between them shade the loss and the gain, animating left and width on glide — except while a finger is down, when the transition drops to zero so a band tracks the hand instead of trailing it. The R multiple eases through a motion value on snap and turns success when it crosses the threshold; each handle is a slider where arrows step, Shift or Page steps ten at a time, and Home and End jump to the limits its neighbours leave it.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial { stop, entry, target } prices.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the drag or key that moved a handle.

props.name: low
props.description: Left end of the rail's price domain.

props.name: high
props.description: Right end of the rail's price domain.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow-key increment; drags snap to it.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of entry the stop sits on; a short reverses the rail.

props.name: size
props.description: Units, so risk and reward read as money.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Instrument code in the header.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the risk and reward money.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats the three prices.

props.name: goodAt
props.description: R at which the ratio and the gain band turn success.

props.name: minGap
props.description: Smallest distance allowed between handles.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology.

usageNotes: Each handle is a slider button: Left and Down step down, Right and Up step up, Shift or PageUp/PageDown steps ten at a time, and Home and End jump to the limits its neighbours leave it.
Pointer capture is taken only after 4px of travel and inside try/catch, so a plain tap still lands and a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
Under reduced motion nothing springs, but the bands, the ratio and its threshold colour all still change — that is the information the rail carries.

items.title: Depth Mound
items.tagline: Liquidity as a landscape.
items.description: Liquidity as terrain. Bids pile up leftward from an anchored mid line and asks rightward, each column as tall as the cumulative size out to its price, and a new book re-grows them on glide delayed by cascade outward from the mid, with a flash on every level that actually changed. The plate is a slider: a pointer snaps the crosshair to the nearest column, Left and Right step one level, Home and End jump to the deepest bid and ask, Escape clears it, and the cumulative figure eases on flick from a motion value.

props.name: bids
props.description: Bid levels, best first, descending price.

props.name: asks
props.description: Ask levels, best first, ascending price.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px; the width is fluid.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the notional in the accessible reading.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats prices.

props.name: formatSize
props.description: Formats sizes and cumulative depth.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Instrument code beside the mid.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the plot.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that moved the crosshair.

usageNotes: The plate is a slider over the levels: Left and Right step one, Up and Down likewise, Home and End jump to the deepest bid and ask, Escape clears the crosshair, and focus opens it at the best bid.
The whole book is also rendered as a visually hidden table of side, price, size and cumulative depth, so the chart means something with no pointer at all.
Under reduced motion the columns still change height and the crosshair still moves — depth is the information — but with no stagger, no spring and no flash travel.

items.title: Trade Confirm
items.tagline: The last look at the number.
items.description: The last look at the number. The sheet rises inside its own frame on glide — never a bounce, because nothing is worth celebrating until the order is placed — while a ring beside the quote drains linearly across the hold from a motion value, pausing whenever the tab is hidden. Expiry dims the quote in place, disables confirm rather than hiding it, and slides a refresh control into the hold line; a new price rolls the digits on snap and refills the ring. Focus enters on Confirm, Tab cycles inside, Escape cancels, and focus returns to whatever opened it.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial visibility.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or confirm that changed it.

props.name: side
props.description: Order side; colours the header chip.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Instrument code.

props.name: size
props.description: Units on the order.

props.name: price
props.description: The held quote. A new value rolls the digits and restarts the hold.

props.name: fee
props.description: Added to the total.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: Milliseconds the quote holds before it expires.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the fee and the total.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats the quote.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Noun printed after the size.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Fires from the press that confirmed, with the quote it confirmed.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Fires from the press that asked for a new quote.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Fires from the ring's completion.

usageNotes: Renders absolutely inside the nearest positioned ancestor — give the surface it belongs to `relative`.
A real modal: focus enters on Confirm, Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the sheet, Escape cancels, and focus returns to whatever opened it.
Hiding the document pauses the hold and showing it again resumes from what was left, so a quote never expires on a screen nobody is watching.
Under reduced motion the sheet fades in place, digits swap instead of rolling, and the ring still drains at the same linear rate.

items.title: Market Clock
items.tagline: Open, closed, and how long until.
items.description: A twenty-four hour face that draws a venue's sessions as arcs where they actually sit. The hand sweeps from a minute the host supplies, its rotation accumulated across midnight so it never unwinds a full turn, on a linear tween matched to the step. The arc between the hand and the next change shrinks as the hand eats it and breathes on drift once the change is close; the state pill snaps between Open and Closed, and each legend row is a button that pins the countdown to its session, with Escape to unpin.

props.name: minute
props.description: Minutes since midnight, possibly fractional. The host owns the clock, so the face stays deterministic on the server.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Open stretches as { label, from, to } in minutes; everything outside them is closed.

props.name: label
props.description: Venue name; the group's accessible name.

props.name: zone
props.description: Small caption under the venue name.

props.name: soonMinutes
props.description: How close the next change must be before the arc ahead breathes.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned session label.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that pinned or cleared a session.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires from the effect that observed the flip, once per flip.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Formats every time on the face and in the legend.

usageNotes: Each legend row is a real button with aria-pressed: Enter or Space pins the countdown to that session, a second press or Escape anywhere in the group clears it.

The face is a role="img" whose label names the state, the countdown and every session's hours, and a status region carries only the word Open or Closed so it speaks once per flip rather than once per tick.
Under reduced motion the hand jumps to its minute and the arc ahead stops breathing, but the arcs, the state and the countdown all still update.

items.title: Holdings Ring
items.tagline: Every asset's share of the whole.
items.description: An allocation ring that re-proportions rather than redraws: every asset is one stroked circle whose pathLength is its share and whose pathOffset is its start on the rim, so adding or removing an asset animates two numbers on glide and the whole ring settles as one body. Segments draw in on a cascade at mount and shrink away on the exit ease, while pointing at one lifts it along its own mid angle on snap and cross-fades the hub to that asset's amount and share. The SVG is decorative; the legend under it is a real radiogroup with a roving tabindex where arrows step, Home and End jump, Space selects and Escape hands the hub back to the total.

props.name: assets
props.description: The mix clockwise from twelve o'clock: id, label and value. Non-positive assets are dropped.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial selected asset id; null reads the portfolio total.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click, key or Escape that changed the selection.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group heading; omit it and pass aria-label to name the ring invisibly.

props.name: totalLabel
props.description: Caption over the hub figure while nothing is selected.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Segment stroke width in the 120-unit viewBox.

usageNotes: The legend is a radiogroup with a roving tabindex: Up and Down (or Left and Right) step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the outer assets, Space selects and Escape clears back to the total.
Each legend entry's accessible name spells out the asset, its amount and its share, so nothing depends on the ring or on colour.
Under reduced motion the segments render at their share with no draw-in and re-proportion instantly; the active one is marked by opacity and stroke rather than a lift.

items.title: Performance Line
items.tagline: Since when, and how far.
items.description: A performance chart whose period selector redraws the trace instead of cross-fading it: switching remounts a clip rectangle at zero width that opens across the plate on a durations.page tween, wiping the new line and its fill in from the left. The pill under the chosen period travels on a useId-prefixed layoutId on snap, the return figure rolls its digits on the same spring with a caret that turns to match the sign, and the start marker labels itself once the wipe has passed. The selector is a real tablist with a roving tabindex — Left and Right step, Home and End jump, focus activates — and the plate is its panel with an aria-label sentence stating the whole period.

props.name: periods
props.description: Each period's id, short tab label, an already-formatted start label, and its closes oldest first.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial period id; defaults to the first period.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that changed the period.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the current value and the start chip's opening figure.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading beside the selector; omit it and pass aria-label.

props.name: height
props.description: Plate height in px. The width is fluid and every marker is placed in percentages.

usageNotes: A tablist with a roving tabindex: Left and Right (or Up and Down) step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the outer periods, and focus activates the period.
Pass `since` as an already-formatted date string — the chart never reads a clock, so the server and the client always draw the same label.
Under reduced motion there is no wipe: the new trace is simply there, complete, and the digits swap in place rather than rolling.

items.title: Rebalance Bars
items.tagline: Current, target, and the moves between.
items.description: Paired bars per asset — Now, solid, and Target, hatched behind a hairline — so the gap between them is the drift. Pressing the action glides every Now bar to its target on a cascade, glide rather than recoil because a portfolio reaching its model is a weight settling and a sale should never celebrate; a warn-hatched drift lane rides the Now track from where the weight stands to where it belongs and closes to nothing as the bar lands. Each pair is a role="meter" whose aria-valuetext states the whole trade in a sentence, and the action is a real button that disables itself once nothing is left to trade.

props.name: assets
props.description: Each asset's id, label, current weight and target weight in whole percentage points.

props.name: total
props.description: The portfolio's value; each trade's cash amount is its weight change against this.

props.name: applied / defaultApplied
props.description: Controlled or initial state of the rebalance; true draws every Now bar at its target.

props.name: onAppliedChange
props.description: Fires from the button press, never from inside a state updater.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats each trade's cash amount and the total left to move.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Copy on the action button, which appends the number of trades.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label to name the list.

usageNotes: The action is the only gesture: Enter and Space press it, and it disables itself with a spoken reason once every row is on target.
Buy and sell are a caret, a word and a hatch as well as a colour, and the summary line above the rows is a role="status" that announces once rather than per row.
Under reduced motion the bars still reach their targets — instantly, with no stagger — the drift lane closes on a colour tween and the tick appears already drawn.

items.title: Holding Row
items.tagline: A position that opens its history.
items.description: A position that opens its history. Pressing the row expands the panel on glide to a height a ResizeObserver measured on the content, so no room is reserved for a panel that is not showing; inside, the mini trace draws its pathLength while the fill scales off the baseline and the lot rows arrive on a cascade. A change in price is caught by comparing the incoming prop with the committed one during render — no clock — and each catch remounts a wash that flashes behind the change chip while the value swaps in a slot sized by an invisible copy of itself, so the row never reflows mid-tick. The header is a real aria-expanded button: Enter and Space toggle, Escape closes and returns focus.

props.name: symbol
props.description: The invented ticker, set in mono; it also names the panel.

props.name: name
