props.description: The position's full name, truncated with a title when it will not fit.

props.name: quantity
props.description: Units held; the market value is quantity times price.

props.name: price
props.description: Last price. A change flashes the chip and swaps the value in its slot.

props.name: changePercent
props.description: Session change in percent; its sign drives the chip's colour and caret.

props.name: history
props.description: Seeded closes, oldest first, for the mini trace. Fewer than two points hides the chart.

props.name: lots
props.description: Each lot's id, an already-formatted date, its quantity and its cost.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial expansion of the history panel.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that changed the expansion.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

usageNotes: Enter and Space toggle the row; Escape closes it and returns focus to the header. The panel is a labelled region and is aria-hidden while closed.
Drive `price` from your own feed: the flash is derived from the prop during render, so the row never reads a clock and never needs a timer of its own.
Under reduced motion the panel opens instantly and the trace renders already drawn, but the chip still flashes — a price tick is feedback, not flourish.

items.title: Allocation Slider
items.tagline: Move one; the others give.
items.description: A stack of allocation sliders that always sum to 100. The row under the pointer is exact — its fill and thumb track the finger with duration 0, because direct manipulation must never lag behind the hand — while every other row eases to its new share on glide, so what you hold is instant and what answers is sprung. Whatever the held row gives up is shared out by largest remainder against a snapshot taken when the gesture began, so the whole numbers on screen sum to exactly 100 on every frame and the untouched rows keep their ratios. Each track is a real role="slider": arrows step, Page keys move five, Home and End reach the ends of the pool, and a per-row lock switch takes that row out of the pool on snap.

props.name: slices
props.description: The rows top to bottom: an id and a label each.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial whole-percent weights aligned to slices by index; normalised to sum to 100, defaulting to an even split.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that changed the mix, never from a render or a state updater.

props.name: total
props.description: The portfolio's value; given it, each row prints its cash share in tabular figures.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats each row's cash share. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: step
props.description: Percentage points per arrow key; Page keys move five steps.

props.name: lockable
props.description: Renders the per-row lock switch. A locked row never gives and never takes.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Every track is a slider: Left and Down step down, Right and Up step up, PageUp and PageDown move five steps, Home goes to 0 and End to whatever the locks leave in the pool.
Pointer travel under 4px never captures, so a plain click on a track sets that row; past 4px the capture and its release are both guarded so a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
Under reduced motion the other rows jump to their new shares instead of springing and the lock's shackle swaps, but the fills still fill and the numbers still count.

items.title: Dividend Calendar
items.tagline: Payouts, on the days they land.
items.description: A month of payouts on the days they land. Every paying day carries a drawn coin that drops from a shift above its cell and lands on recoil, staggered by cascade so a busy month stays inside the choreography budget, and the month total rolls on snap between months — up when the new month pays more. It is a real grid: arrows walk the days, Home and End reach the ends of a week, PageUp and PageDown change month, and pressing a day pins its reading until Escape.

props.name: months
props.description: The months the arrows walk: id, label, days, the weekday the 1st falls on, and the payouts.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial month id.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the arrow or key that changed month.

props.name: onDayRead
props.type: (day: number | null, payout: DividendPayout | null) => void
props.description: Fires from the pointer, focus or press that changed what the header reads; null when nothing is being read.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount, including the month total.

props.name: weekdays
props.description: Seven column headers, Monday first.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: A grid of day buttons with a roving tabindex: arrows walk the days, Home and End reach the ends of a week, PageUp and PageDown change month keeping the day, Enter or Space pins a day's reading and Escape releases it.
The reading appears in the header rather than a floating tooltip, so nothing can leave the frame at narrow widths.
Under reduced motion the coins are simply present at full scale and the total's digits swap in place — which days pay is information, not flourish.

items.title: Gain Loss Bar
items.tagline: Green to the right, red to the left.
items.description: A holding's day measured from a centre line: gains grow right in success, losses grow left in danger, all scaled against the largest move so the longest bar reaches the edge. Bars unroll out of the axis on glide with a cascade on the first paint only, and the sort control re-orders the rows with FLIP on glide so a row travels to its place rather than blinking there. The sort is a radiogroup with a roving tabindex — arrows step, Home and End jump, Space selects.

props.name: holdings
props.description: The set: id, label, the money moved and the same move in percent.

props.name: sort / defaultSort
props.description: Controlled or initial sort; changing it re-orders the rows with FLIP.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that changed the sort.

props.name: basis
props.description: Which figure the bars and row readouts measure; changing it re-scales every bar at once.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every money figure, including the net.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The sort control is a radiogroup with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Space selects.
Each row's visible label and figure are hidden from assistive technology and replaced by one sentence, so direction is spoken as a word rather than resting on a plus sign or a colour.
Under reduced motion the bars are at full length on the first paint and rows swap into their sorted places without travelling — the arrangement is the information.

items.title: Cost Basis
items.tagline: What you paid, against what it is worth.
items.description: What you paid, against what it is worth. A neutral base fill runs to the paid mark and a coloured extension fills from there toward worth — right in success, left in danger — both as transforms settling on glide, and the per-share toggle rolls both figures on snap while the lane deliberately holds still, because dividing both numbers by the same share count changes no ratio. The toggle is a real switch reached by Tab and flipped with Space.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Instrument code printed under the lane.

props.name: shares
props.description: Units held; divides both totals for the per-share view.

props.name: costPerShare
props.description: Average price paid — the lane's mark.

props.name: price
props.description: Current mark. A new value re-fills the lane on glide and rolls the worth figure.

props.name: perShare / defaultPerShare
props.description: Controlled or initial state of the per-share toggle.

props.name: onPerShareChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key that flipped the toggle.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the position totals.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats the per-share figures.

props.name: headroom
props.description: Slack past the larger figure so a full lane never touches the edge.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The per-share control is a role="switch" with aria-checked: Tab reaches it, Space or Enter flips it.
The lane is scaled from the position totals, never from the displayed figures, so flipping to per-share cannot twitch a bar whose ratio did not change.
Under reduced motion the digits swap in place and the fills jump to their new geometry — the gap between paid and worth is information, so it is never withheld.

items.title: Portfolio Pulse
items.tagline: The whole book, one beat.
items.description: A whole book in one beat. Each tick rolls the total's digit columns one face on snap in the direction the money moved, extends the trace with a segment that draws on flick, and fires the beat dot — a ring that expands and fades on a tween over a dot landing back from 1.4× on flick — while a full window slides left by one pitch on glide from a motion value. After quietMs of no change the beat stills and one polite sentence is announced, never one per tick.

props.name: value
props.description: The book's mark. A new value rolls the total, extends the trace and fires the beat.

props.name: open
props.description: Session open — the basis for the change chip.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading on the card.

props.name: venue
props.description: Quiet mono line opposite the heading.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the total and the change.

props.name: points
props.description: Length of the trail window; older marks fall off the left.

props.name: quietMs
props.description: Quiet after which the beat stills and the sentence is announced.

props.name: onTick
props.description: Fires from the effect that observed the committed tick, never from a render.

usageNotes: The card never generates a tick: drive it from a prop and it rolls what it is given, reporting each committed tick through onTick.
The sentence is written once the tape has been quiet for quietMs, so a burst of prints announces the settled book once instead of once per print.
Under reduced motion the ring never fires and the trace extends without travelling, but the digits still update and the beat dot still changes tone between live and still.

items.title: Watch Drag
items.tagline: Sort your holdings by hand.
items.description: A watchlist you rank by hand. Pressing a row's grip lifts it on flick and then tracks the pointer 1:1 with no easing, while the rows it passes make room with FLIP on glide, a dashed slot marks the place it will take, and the drop settles it there on glide before a cobalt wash leaves on the exit ease. Space lifts, Up and Down move, Home and End reach the ends, Space drops and Escape restores — every step announced by name and position.

props.name: holdings
props.description: The watchlist: id, symbol, name, price and the day's move in percent.

props.name: order / defaultOrder
props.description: Controlled or initial order as ids; unknown ids are ignored and missing ones appended.

props.name: onOrderChange
props.description: Fires from the drop, or from each key that committed a move, never from inside a state updater.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every price.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Only the grip is focusable, so Tab walks ranks rather than every readout: Space or Enter lifts and drops, Up and Down move a lifted row and otherwise move focus, Home and End reach the ends, Escape cancels and restores the order the lift started from.
The pointer is captured only after 4px of travel and inside try/catch both ways, so a plain tap still lands and a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
Under reduced motion nothing travels — the list reorders live as the pointer crosses each row, because the order is the information, not the flight.

items.title: Seed Reveal
items.tagline: Twelve words, one at a time.
items.description: A recovery phrase under hatched plates that lift one at a time while the control is held, each on snap with the word beneath arriving from a nudge; letting go re-covers the grid on the exit ease. The furthest word reached is kept as seen, and the copy control stays shut until every word has shown. Space or Enter held down runs the same walk as a press, Escape or blur ends it.

props.name: words
props.description: The phrase, in order. Twelve or twenty-four — the grid takes any length.

props.name: revealMs
props.description: Milliseconds between words while the control is held.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading for the card.

props.name: holdLabel
props.description: Copy on the hold control.

props.name: onSeenChange
props.description: Fires from the tick that uncovers a word never seen before.

props.name: onRevealComplete
props.description: Fires from the tick that uncovers the last word.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Fires from the copy press once the clipboard has answered.

usageNotes: The hold control is a real button: Space or Enter held down reveals (auto-repeat ignored), releasing the key ends the hold, and Escape or blur ends it early.
Covered words are not in the accessibility tree — each slot reads "Word 3, hidden" until its plate is off — and copy stays disabled until every word has been seen.
Under reduced motion the plates swap instead of lifting, but the walk still steps and the meter still fills, because how far the reveal got is information.

items.title: Seed Confirm
items.tagline: Put the words back in order.
items.description: The check that follows a backup: a right pick flies its chip out of the tray and into the numbered slot on a shared layoutId move on glide, while the tray closes the gap behind it on the same spring. A wrong pick never moves — the chip shakes on a four-keyframe tween, the active slot tints danger, and the miss is counted — and the last placement stamps a seal on recoil. The tray is a roving-tabindex group: Arrow keys step, Home and End jump, Enter or Space picks, Backspace undoes.

props.name: positions
props.description: The word numbers being checked, in ask order.

props.name: answers
props.description: The correct word for each position; same length as positions.

props.name: options
props.description: The tray in display order — answers plus decoys, distinct, so the shuffle stays deterministic.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial placements, shortest first.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pick or the undo that changed the placements.

props.name: onMistake
props.description: Fires from the pick that put the wrong word in the active slot.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires from the pick that filled the last slot.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading for the card.

usageNotes: The tray carries a roving tabindex: Arrow keys step without wrapping, Home and End jump, Enter or Space picks, Backspace or Delete returns the last placed word.
Slots are an ordered list where each row reads "Word 7, empty" or "Word 7, anchor", and every outcome is spoken by a polite status region rather than shown in colour alone.
Under reduced motion chips swap into their slots instead of flying and a refusal tints rather than shakes, while the fill count and miss tally still update.

items.title: Address Chip
items.tagline: The middle you never read.
items.description: An address shown head-and-tail with the middle collapsed to a real zero-width box; hover or focus glides it open to the width a ResizeObserver measured on the inner run, and the three dots close as the characters arrive. Pressing copies the whole address, draws the tick on flick and stamps a pill over the chip on recoil. Enter or Space copies, Escape shuts the middle without giving up focus.

props.name: address
props.description: The full address. Copied verbatim — the clipboard never gets the abbreviation.

props.name: head
props.description: Characters kept before the collapsed middle.

props.name: tail
props.description: Characters kept after it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the chip for assistive technology and titles the copy action.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Forces the middle open (or shut) regardless of hover and focus.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires from the hover, focus, or Escape that changed the middle's state.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Fires from the copy press once the clipboard has answered.

usageNotes: One real button: focus expands the middle exactly as hover does, Enter or Space copies, and Escape collapses it again without moving focus.
The aria-label carries the full address, so a screen reader never reconstructs the middle from an ellipsis, and a refused clipboard is announced rather than hidden.
The address sits in its own overflow-x-auto strip with edge fades, so an address wider than the card scrolls inside the chip instead of pushing the page sideways.
Under reduced motion the middle appears at full width with no glide and the stamp fades in square.

items.title: Sign Request
items.tagline: Read what you are signing.
items.description: A signing sheet that rises inside the wallet's own frame from a shift on glide and lays the request out one row at a time, each arriving from a nudge behind a cascade delay. A scroll listener writes reading progress into a motion value that scales the hairline beneath the list, and reaching the end arms the sign control, whose fill sweeps in from the left on snap. Focus moves to the list on open and back to the opener on close, Tab is trapped, Escape rejects, and a press on the closed gate takes the reader to the end instead.

props.name: open
props.description: Raises the sheet. Render it inside a relative frame.

props.name: fields
props.description: The request in reading order: id, label, value or amount, and an optional warn tone.

props.name: origin
props.description: Who is asking. Shown under the title and read out with it.

props.name: title
props.description: Sheet heading and the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: format
props.description: Every amount goes through this — the sheet never invents a currency.

props.name: signLabel
props.description: Copy on the arming control.

props.name: onSign
props.description: Fires from the sign press, only ever while armed.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Fires from the reject press, the scrim, or Escape.

props.name: onArmedChange
props.description: Fires from the scroll or resize callback that armed or disarmed the control.

usageNotes: A real dialog: focus moves to the field list on open so PageDown reads immediately, Tab and Shift+Tab are trapped inside the sheet, Escape rejects, and focus returns to the opener on close.
The gate is an aria-disabled control with a reason attached, not a dead button — a press while closed takes the reader to the end, and a Jump to end control gives the same path without scrolling.
Warn-toned rows carry the word Warning as well as the colour, and a request too short to scroll arms on its own from the ResizeObserver.
Under reduced motion nothing travels and the fill swaps colour, while the reading hairline still tracks the scroll.

items.title: Wallet Connect
items.tagline: The handshake, drawn.
items.description: The handshake drawn as two nodes closing the distance: asking narrows the rail they are pinned to on glide, so they approach without either owning a pixel measurement, while the wallet node breathes on a slow reversing tween. Approval draws the link across on glide and lands a tick in a disc at the join on flick; refusal snaps them apart on snap while the link falls away on the exit ease. One real button carries the whole flow — Connect, Cancel, Disconnect, Try again — and a status line says the state in words.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial state of the handshake.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the press that changed the state.

props.name: appName
props.description: Who is asking. Its node draws the initials.

props.name: walletName
props.description: Who is being asked. Its node draws a wallet.

props.name: address
props.description: Shown abbreviated under the stage once connected, and spoken in full.

props.name: onRequest
props.description: Fires from the connect press, before the host has answered.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fires from the cancel press while pending.

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: Fires from the disconnect press while connected.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading for the card.

usageNotes: The whole flow runs from one real button whose label follows the state, so Enter and Space reach every step; there is no pointer-only path.
The stage is decoration — a status region beneath it carries the state in words and the full address, so the outcome is never colour or drawing alone.
The rail is sized as a share of the stage rather than in pixels, so the approach reads the same at 342px as at full width.
Under reduced motion the nodes hold one position, the link swaps from dashed to solid, the tick appears complete and the wallet node does not breathe.

items.title: Network Pick
items.tagline: Switch chains without losing your place.
items.description: A wallet header that changes chain without moving anything else. Picking a chain wipes its tone across the header on a clipPath tween that enters from the side the pick lies on, while the chain badge leaves on the exit ease and the new one arrives from 8px away on snap, and the balance beneath re-rolls its digit columns on snap in a cascade that starts at the units and ripples left. It is a radio group with a roving tabindex — Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump, Space selects — and under reduced motion the wash cross-fades, the badge swaps in place and the digits jump to their faces.

props.name: chains
props.description: The chains left to right: id, name, symbol, a token tone, a native balance and its value in the reporting currency.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial chain id; defaults to the first chain.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or key that changed the pick.

props.name: format
props.description: Prints the headline figure. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: formatUnits
props.defaultValue: four fraction digits then the symbol
props.description: Prints the native balance under the headline.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group label; omit it and pass aria-label to label the group invisibly.

props.name: caption
props.description: A quiet line under the balance — the account the header belongs to.

usageNotes: A radio group with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step between chains without wrapping past the ends, Home and End jump, and Space selects. Moving focus selects, as a radio group does.

Under reduced motion the wash cross-fades instead of wiping, the badge swaps in place and the digit columns jump to their faces — the tone and the figure still change, because which chain you are on is the information.
The rolling columns and the ghost badges are hidden from assistive technology; one sr-only status sentence carries the chain, the native balance and the reporting figure on each switch.
Chain colour comes from a token tone — cobalt, signal, success, warn or danger — never a hex, so both themes read.

items.title: Gas Dial
items.tagline: Slow, normal, fast, and what each costs.
items.description: Three speeds, a needle, and what each one costs. The needle rides a motion value animated on glide — a needle crossing an arc eases into position rather than overshooting — and the same value drives the filled arc's pathLength, so the sweep and the needle are one movement; the fee rolls its digit columns on snap and the estimated time counts, a second motion value read straight into the readout so the clock counts without re-rendering a frame of it. The three stops are a radio group with a roving tabindex — Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Space selects — and the dial face is a pointer shortcut that picks the nearest detent by angle, capturing only after 4px of travel.

props.name: stops
props.description: Exactly three stops, slowest first: id, label, fee in major units, estimated seconds and an optional network rate.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial stop id; defaults to the middle stop.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key or dial gesture that changed the stop.

props.name: format
props.description: Prints the fee. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: rateUnit
props.description: Unit printed after a stop's rate in the mono chip.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group label; omit it and pass aria-label to label the group invisibly.

usageNotes: The stops are a radio group with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping past the ends, Home and End jump to slow and fast, and Space selects. The dial face is a pointer shortcut only — every speed is reachable from the keyboard.
Pointer capture on the dial waits for 4px of travel and is taken and released inside try/catch, so a plain click is never swallowed and a synthetic sweep through the specimen cannot throw.

Under reduced motion the needle and the arc set to their stop at once and the clock arrives at its value instead of counting to it — the fee and the wait still change, because what a speed costs is the information.
The rolling fee columns are hidden from assistive technology; one sr-only status sentence carries the speed, the fee and the estimated wait.

items.title: QR Fold
items.tagline: Show the code; hide the code.
items.description: A receive card whose payment code lives folded into a strip until you ask for it. Pressing unfolds it: the wrapper's height glides from the strip to the square's ResizeObserver-measured height while the code scales up from its top edge, so it reads as paper opening downwards rather than a box growing, and folding away runs back on the exit ease because exits never spring. The toggle carries aria-expanded, Escape anywhere in the card folds the code and returns focus to it, and the address chip beneath copies with a tick drawn on flick.

props.name: address
props.description: The receiving address. Seeds the procedural code and fills the copy chip.

props.name: label
props.description: Card heading; names the card for assistive technology.

props.name: network
props.description: Chain or rail the address belongs to; shown as a mono chip and named in the code's label.

props.name: amount
props.description: Requested amount in major units. Omit it for an open request.

props.name: format
props.description: Prints the requested amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial fold state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that changed the fold.

props.name: modules
props.description: Grid size of the procedural code; clamped to 21–33 and forced odd.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Fires from the copy attempt with whether the clipboard took it.

usageNotes: The strip is a real toggle with aria-expanded and aria-controls; Escape anywhere inside the card folds the code and hands focus back to it.
The code is procedural and fake — a hash of the address seeds the grid, drawn as one SVG path — so nothing is fetched and nothing is scannable.
Under reduced motion the height and the fold set at once and the code cross-fades in, because whether the code is showing is the point of the control.
A clipboard that refuses shows a failure mark and announces "Clipboard unavailable" rather than claiming a copy that never happened.

items.title: Key Vault
items.tagline: Locked, unlocked, and how long for.
items.description: A vault whose lock says both that it is open and how long it stays open. Flipping the switch turns the lock on snap — the shackle lifts and the keyway takes a quarter turn in one crisp overshoot — while an auto-lock ring drains linearly from a motion value, stopping while the tab is hidden and resuming from what is left, and the vault locks itself from that animation's completion rather than from inside a state updater. The keys exist only while the vault is open, arriving from 8px away on glide in a cascade; the lock is a role="switch", each reveal is an aria-pressed button, and Escape anywhere inside locks the vault and returns focus to the switch.

props.name: keys
props.description: The keys in order: id, label, kind and the secret value, which stays masked until an explicit reveal.

props.name: label
props.description: Vault name; labels the card and the key list.

props.name: unlocked / defaultUnlocked
props.description: Controlled or initial lock state.

props.name: onUnlockedChange
props.description: Fires from the switch, the Escape, or the ring running out.

props.name: autoLockMs
props.description: Milliseconds the vault stays open; 0 disables the ring and the auto-lock.

props.name: onAutoLock
props.description: Fires from the ring's completion when the vault locks itself.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: Fires from the press that revealed or re-masked a value.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Fires from the copy attempt with whether the clipboard took it.

usageNotes: The lock is a role="switch" with aria-checked that Space and Enter flip; Escape anywhere inside the card locks the vault and hands focus back to it.
Locked, the rows are unmounted rather than hidden — a sealed vault keeps no values in the document and nothing focusable behind a closed drawer.
Revealing or copying re-arms the ring, and the drain stops while the tab is hidden and resumes from what is left rather than restarting.
Under reduced motion the lock swaps without turning and rows fade instead of sliding, but the ring still drains at the same linear rate, because how long you have is information.

items.title: Hardware Nudge
items.tagline: Confirm on the device.
items.description: A prompt that waits on a physical signer. While the request is out the device outline pulses on a repeating tween — a breath repeats, and a spring is a single arrival — and a deadline bar drains linearly from a motion value that stops while the tab is hidden and resumes from what is left, with the seconds read straight into the text so the clock counts without re-rendering a frame of it. When the confirmation lands the button lights and the tick draws on flick while the device settles on recoil; a timeout does not celebrate, it dims and greys on a colour tween, and one button — send, cancel or send again — keeps the card the same height in every state.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial state of the request.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the drain that changed the state.

props.name: deviceName
props.description: The device being waited on; named in every state sentence.

props.name: amount
props.description: Amount awaiting confirmation, in major units of the reporting currency.

props.name: format
props.description: Prints the amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: units / symbol
props.description: Native amount and its ticker, printed above the reporting figure.

props.name: to
props.description: Destination address; shown head and tail in mono with a full title.

props.name: timeoutMs
props.description: Milliseconds before the request expires; 0 waits forever and hides the deadline.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Fires from the drain's completion when the request times out.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fires from the press that sent or re-sent the request.

usageNotes: One real button covers every state — send, cancel, send again, and a disabled Confirmed — so the card keeps its height and the whole flow is one Tab away.
The visible line under the device is the live region: a reader hears one sentence per state rather than a per-second tick.
The deadline drain stops while the tab is hidden and resumes from what is left, and the request expires from the animation's completion rather than from inside a state updater.
Under reduced motion the outline holds a steady ring instead of breathing and the device does not bounce, but the button still lights, the tick still appears and the clock still counts.

items.title: Tx Status
items.tagline: Pending, then confirmed, block by block.
items.description: A transfer watched until it settles: each block that lands takes the next slot, arriving from a step to the right on snap, while the track beneath extends on glide and the count swaps on snap so the figure moves with the tile. At the threshold the pill stamps from 1.2x on recoil and its check draws on flick, while a dropped transfer only cross-fades because a failure must never celebrate. Landed tiles are buttons on a roving tabindex where Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Enter pins a block's detail and Escape releases it.

props.name: hash
props.description: The transfer's identifier: shown head-and-tail, spoken whole.

props.name: amount
props.description: The transferred amount, printed through format.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount.

props.name: asset
props.description: Asset ticker printed after the amount.

props.name: blocks
props.description: Confirming blocks oldest first; its length is the confirmation count.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Confirmations needed for finality, and the number of slots drawn.

props.name: dropped
props.description: Marks the transfer as dropped from the queue and suppresses the stamp.

props.name: label
props.description: Heads the amount and names the card.

props.name: onBlockSelect
props.description: Fires from the press that pins or unpins a block.

props.name: onFinal
props.description: Fires once, when the threshold is first met.

usageNotes: Landed tiles carry a roving tabindex: Left and Right step, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pins a block so its detail survives the pointer leaving, Escape releases it.
Under reduced motion tiles appear in place and the track still extends, because how many blocks have landed is information rather than flourish.
Nothing is timed inside the card: the host lands blocks by appending to blocks, so the ticker and its cleanup stay where the data lives.

items.title: Block Stream
items.tagline: Blocks as they are mined.
items.description: A rail of blocks that fills from the right: a new block enters from a shift beyond the right edge on snap while the tiles already on the rail slide one place left under a layout animation on glide, and the tile pushed off the end leaves on the exit ease. Each tile carries its height, its transaction count, and a fullness bar that extends on glide. Pointing at the rail or focusing any tile holds the stream through onPauseChange, and tiles are buttons on a roving tabindex where Left and Right step, Home and End jump, and Enter pins a tile's detail.

props.name: blocks
props.description: Blocks oldest first; the newest sits at the right of the rail.

props.name: max
props.description: Tiles kept on the rail; older ones leave to the left.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Transactions a full block holds; sets each fullness bar.

props.name: paused
props.description: Host-driven hold, OR-ed with the pointer and focus hold.

props.name: onPauseChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or focus event that changed the hold.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires from the press that pins or unpins a tile.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats heights and transaction counts.

props.name: announce
props.description: Announces each settled block politely; turn it off in a busy page.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the rail for assistive technology.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown while the rail is empty.

usageNotes: Tiles carry a roving tabindex: Left and Right step, Home and End jump to the oldest and newest tile on the rail, Enter or Space pins a tile, Escape releases it. Focus holds the stream exactly as hover does, so the keyboard can read a tile without it sliding away.
Under reduced motion tiles appear in place and leave the same way, and the fullness bars still extend, because how full a block is is information.
The rail never overflows: tiles flex to the width available, so only the entering tile's travel is clipped.

items.title: Gas Tracker
items.tagline: The fee, live.
items.description: A fee readout with its own recent past. The headline rolls on snap so only the digit columns that changed move, while the history strip extends: each reading arrives at the right of a fixed grid and its bar scales up from its base on glide. A dashed ceiling crosses the strip, bars at or above it draw in warn, and a crossing tints the headline. The strip is a real slider: pointing reads the nearest column, Left and Right step through the run, Home and End jump, and Escape releases the cursor back to live.

props.name: value
props.description: The current reading, in unit.

props.name: history
props.description: Earlier readings oldest first; the current one is appended for the strip.

props.name: threshold
props.description: The ceiling: crossing it colours the readout and the bars above it.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Columns in the strip; the grid is fixed, so a long run cannot overflow.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit printed after every figure and spoken in labels.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every figure on the card.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tracker for assistive technology.

props.name: selectedIndex / defaultSelectedIndex
props.description: Cursor position as an index into the drawn window; null is live.

props.name: onSelectedIndexChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer, key, or Escape that moved the cursor.

usageNotes: The strip is a role=slider with tabIndex 0: Left and Right step through the readings, Home and End jump to the oldest and newest, Escape releases the cursor back to live. A cursor placed with the keys outlives the pointer wandering off.
Under reduced motion the digits swap in place and the bars still extend on a tween, because the history is information rather than flourish.
The live region carries only the ceiling verdict, so it speaks on a crossing rather than once per sample.

items.title: Tx Flow
items.tagline: From this address to that one.
items.description: One transaction, drawn: every input curves into a hub and every output curves out of it, each edge weighted by that leg's share of the total. Value marches along the edges as a dashed stroke on a linear tween, and only while flowing is set, the tab is visible, and motion is welcome. Pointing at an edge or its row lights both and reads the address and amount, thickening the stroke on glide; rows carry one roving tabindex across both columns where Up and Down move within a column, Left and Right cross between them, Enter pins a leg and Escape releases it.

props.name: inputs
props.description: Addresses the transaction spends from, top to bottom.

props.name: outputs
props.description: Addresses it pays, top to bottom; one may carry kind: "fee".

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount on the diagram.

props.name: asset
props.description: Asset ticker printed after amounts.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned leg id.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or Escape that pinned or released a leg.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or focus that lit a leg.

props.name: flowing
props.description: Marches the dashes; still gated by reduced motion and tab visibility.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the diagram for assistive technology.

usageNotes: One roving tabindex spans both columns: Up and Down move within a column, Left and Right cross to the other at the same row, Home and End jump to the first and last leg, Enter or Space pins a leg and Escape releases it.
Under reduced motion the dashes hold still and each leg's share still reads in its stroke weight; highlighting becomes colour and weight on a tween.
Geometry is measured by a ResizeObserver and every coordinate is rounded before it reaches an attribute, so adding a leg re-draws without a hydration mismatch.

items.title: Mempool Queue
items.tagline: Waiting, ordered by what they pay.
items.description: The waiting room, ordered by what each transaction pays. Rows sort by fee and carry layout on glide, so a reorder is the list rearranging itself and every row travels to its new place; an arrival drops in from a step above on snap and a mined transaction leaves on the exit ease. Your row is washed, ringed, and named in words, and bumping its fee climbs it past the cut line that marks the next block, flashing a wash keyed to the new rank so it fires once per climb and never on a slide backwards. The bump button sits in the tab order and says what fee it would offer.

props.name: entries
props.description: Pending transactions in any order; the queue sorts them by fee.

props.name: blockSlots
props.description: Rows that make the next block; the cut line sits under them.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Rows drawn; the rest are counted in the footer.

props.name: step
props.description: Added to your fee by one press of the bump button.

props.name: unit
props.description: Fee unit printed after every figure.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every fee on the list.

props.name: onBump
props.description: Fires from the press; re-sort by writing entries.

props.name: bumpLabel
props.description: Copy on the bump button.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list for assistive technology.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when the queue is empty.

usageNotes: The only control is the bump button on your row: it is in the tab order, Enter and Space press it, and its label names the fee it would offer. Every row carries its position and whether it makes the next block as a sentence, so nothing rests on colour.
Under reduced motion rows take their new places instantly, because the order is the information and it still changes; the improvement flash still plays, because feedback is not flourish.
Rows past capacity are not rendered at all: a busy queue is counted in the footer rather than grown into the DOM.

items.title: Explorer Search
items.tagline: Paste a hash; watch it resolve.
items.description: A search field that recognises the shape of what you paste before it looks anything up: the leading mark swaps to the recognised kind on flick while the border tweens to cobalt, and a hairline sweeps the field linearly through the debounce so the wait reads as work. The resolved preview card arrives from a step below on glide, and its wrapper's height is measured with a ResizeObserver so no room is ever reserved for a card that has not resolved. Enter opens the record, Escape clears the field, and a polite status region announces each outcome once instead of on every keystroke.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial query text.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the input, the clear press or Escape.

props.name: resolve
props.description: Looks the query up. Called from the debounce timer, never during render.

props.name: resolveDelayMs
props.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and the lookup; the sweep runs for exactly this long.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount on the preview card. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: asset
props.description: Ticker printed after each amount.

props.name: onKindChange
props.description: Fires when the recognised shape changes — hash, address, block or unknown.

props.name: onResolved
props.description: Fires from the resolve timer with the record, or null for no match.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fires from Enter in the field or the card's open press.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible field label; omit it and pass aria-label to label the field invisibly.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Field placeholder.

usageNotes: The field is a real search input: Enter opens the resolved record, Escape clears the query and dismisses the card, and the card's open control is one Tab away.
Classification is a pure regex over the trimmed query, so it costs nothing per keystroke; only the lookup is debounced, and the debounce pauses while the document is hidden.
Under reduced motion the card cross-fades in place with no slide and no spring, but the debounce sweep still runs, because the wait is information about what the field is doing.

items.title: Finality Ring
items.tagline: How sure the chain is.
items.description: A ring left open at the top, where the notch is the part of finality still owed. Every confirmation extends the arc on glide and draws its own tick on flick, and the last block fills the remaining sweep and closes the notch in one move on snap, so the ring shutting is the same gesture as the transaction settling. The certainty figure rolls its digits on snap inside a fixed five-character box and gives way to a drawn check at finality, because at that point the number is no longer a probability.

props.name: confirmations
props.description: Blocks seen on top of the transaction; clamped to finality for display.

props.name: finality
props.description: Confirmations that count as final — the ring's maximum and its tick count.

props.name: certaintyFor
props.description: Returns 0–1 for the centre figure. The default halves the remaining doubt per block.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum being secured, printed under the ring; omit it and the line is not drawn.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: asset
props.description: Ticker printed after the amount.

props.name: onFinal
props.description: Fires once, from the effect that observes the crossing into finality.

props.name: pendingLabel / finalLabel
props.description: The word under the figure before and after finality.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring scale; the centre figure sizes with it.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible caption over the ring; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: A role="progressbar" carrying the confirmation count and a spoken aria-valuetext; a polite status region announces finality once rather than every block.
The component owns no control and runs no clock — blocks arrive as a prop, so the host decides what a block is and when one lands.
Under reduced motion the arc still fills and the digits still change, on a tween instead of a spring, with no closing overshoot and the check already drawn.

items.title: Nonce Line
items.tagline: Every transaction in order.
items.description: An account's outgoing transactions on one rail in nonce order, where a missing number draws as a dashed slot that breathes on a three-keyframe opacity tween and everything behind it reads as blocked. While the gap stands, the rail carries a break so the blocked tail visibly sits further along than it should; filling the slot collapses that break on glide and slides every transaction behind it forward. The rail is an ordered list with a roving tabindex — Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Enter and Space select or fill — and every tile's label spells its state out in words.

props.name: items
props.description: The transactions: nonce, hash, status, amount and an optional payee. Order does not matter; the line sorts by nonce and draws the missing numbers itself.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial focused nonce; defaults to the lowest on the rail.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key press that moved the selection.

props.name: onFill
props.description: Fires from the press on a gap slot; the host inserts the missing transaction.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount on the rail and in the detail line. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: asset
props.description: Ticker printed after each amount.

props.name: fillLabel
props.description: Word inside a gap slot.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible list label; omit it and pass aria-label to label the rail invisibly.

usageNotes: An ordered list with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter and Space select the tile or fill the gap under focus.
Blocked is derived, never supplied — a pending transaction behind a missing nonce is blocked, and its label says so in words rather than relying on the dimming.
Under reduced motion the slot stops breathing and the break collapses instantly; the order still changes, because the order is the information.

items.title: Bridge Hop
items.tagline: One chain to another, in steps.
items.description: Two chain cards over a hop whose rail carries one node per stage, and a single token puck that crosses it: each completed stage slides the puck to the next node on glide, and the rail itself never fills, so the only thing travelling is the token. The rail's width is measured with a ResizeObserver and the puck moves by x in pixels off that measurement, so it can never overhang at any width; in flight it breathes on drift between two keyframes and stops for a hidden tab. Arrival lands on recoil while the destination balance rolls up on snap, and the stage nodes are real buttons with a roving tabindex whose focus writes the same read-out as hovering.

props.name: stages
props.description: The hop's nodes source to destination: id, label, and an optional detail and hash for the read-out.

props.name: stage
props.description: How many stages have completed; stages.length means arrived.

props.name: from / to
props.description: The two chain cards: a name and a short ticker each.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum crossing, printed as a debit on the source card.

props.name: destinationBalance
props.description: The destination's balance; its digits roll when the transfer lands.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount and the destination balance. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: asset
props.description: Ticker for the amounts; its first letter is the mark on the token.

props.name: failed
props.description: Stops the token on the stage in flight and marks it danger. Nothing bounces on a failure.

props.name: onStageFocus
props.description: Fires from the hover or focus that changed the read-out under the rail.

props.name: onArrive
props.description: Fires once, from the effect that observes the last stage completing.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible caption; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The stages are real buttons with a roving tabindex: Left and Right step without wrapping, Home and End jump, and focus writes the same detail line that hovering does.

State reaches assistive technology in words — each node's label reads "Attested, done" or "Relayed, in progress" — alongside a sr-only progressbar and a status region that announces arrival or failure once.
Under reduced motion the token does not travel or breathe: it takes its position outright, the checks appear already drawn, and the arrival does not bounce.

items.title: Receipt Proof
items.tagline: The proof, drawn as a path.
items.description: A receipt's inclusion proof drawn as the tree it actually is: choosing a leaf picks out the edges that prove it and the sibling hash a verifier needs at every level, and turning the status to checking draws that path leaf-first with each edge's pathLength on glide, staggered by cascade so the climb stays inside the choreography budget. Verifying stamps the root — the seal lands from 1.25× on recoil and its check draws on flick — while a failure only changes colour, because a failure does not celebrate. Hashes are procedural and seeded and every coordinate is rounded before it reaches an attribute, so the tree hydrates identically on the server and in the browser.

props.name: leaves
props.description: Leaf count, rounded up to a power of two so the tree pairs evenly.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial leaf index — the receipt being proved.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the click or key press that chose a leaf.

props.name: status
props.description: Drives the draw and the stamp; the host owns the timing.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the procedural hashes so the same tree is drawn every render.

props.name: amount
props.description: The receipt's value, printed under the tree; omit it and the figure is not drawn.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the amount. The default pins an explicit locale so server and client agree.

props.name: asset
props.description: Ticker printed after the amount.

props.name: onNodeFocus
props.description: Fires from the hover or focus that changed the read-out, with the node's level, index, hash and role.

props.name: rootLabel
props.description: Name of the root node in its label and read-out.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible caption; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Nodes are real buttons over the SVG with a roving tabindex: Left and Right walk a level, Up and Down change level, Home and End jump to a level's ends, Enter and Space choose the leaf under focus.

Every node's label states its part in words — "Leaf 3, on the proof path, hash 4f2a…c19b" — so being on the path is never carried by colour alone, and a polite status region announces the outcome once.
Under reduced motion the path appears already drawn with no stagger and the seal does not arrive from a scale, because which edges prove the receipt is the information rather than the flourish.

items.title: Swap Pair
items.tagline: Flip the pair; the numbers follow.
items.description: A swap card whose two asset fields trade places. Pressing the flip control turns its arrow a half turn on snap while the cards travel between slots as a FLIP on glide, and the inverted rate rolls its digits on snap. The pay field is a real decimal input and the receive field is an output bound to it, so Tab reaches the amount, the Max control and the flip, and Enter or Space reverses the pair.

props.name: assets
props.description: The pair in its base order: { symbol, name, balance }. Index 0 pays while the card is not inverted.

props.name: rate
props.description: Units of assets[1] per one of assets[0]; inverted when the pair flips.

props.name: amount / defaultAmount
props.description: Controlled or initial pay amount, always denominated in the paying asset.

props.name: onAmountChange
props.description: Fires from the keystroke, the Max press, or the flip that rebased the amount.

props.name: inverted / defaultInverted
props.description: Controlled or initial direction; true pays assets[1].

props.name: onInvertedChange
props.description: Fires from the flip press.

props.name: format
props.defaultValue: en-US grouping, 2 dp at 1,000 and above, up to 6 dp below
props.description: Formats every figure the card prints, including the rate.

props.name: feeRate
props.description: Share of the receive figure quoted as the network fee line.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the pay input, the Max button and the flip control; Enter or Space flips the pair, and the flip button's accessible name is the outcome it produces rather than its icon.
Flipping rebases the amount — what you were about to receive becomes what you pay — so a second flip lands back on the figure you started with.
Over balance sets aria-invalid on the input and prints the reason in words beside it, never colour alone; a debounced visually hidden status line reads the settled pair and rate.
Under reduced motion the cards swap slots instantly, the arrow's glyph turns over without rotating and the rate's digits change in place.

items.title: Slippage Dial
items.tagline: How much you will tolerate.
items.description: Three tolerance stops and a custom field share one knob, which travels between them on snap with a single crisp overshoot rather than four chips blinking. The minimum received rolls its digits on snap as the tolerance changes, and a threshold note glides open to a ResizeObserver-measured height so no room is reserved for a state that is usually absent. The stops are a radio group with a roving tabindex — arrows step, Home and End reach the ends, Space selects — and the field is one Tab further on.

props.name: expected
props.description: The quoted receive figure, before any slippage is allowed for.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial tolerance, in percent.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press, key, or keystroke that changed the tolerance.

props.name: presets
props.description: The stops, in percent, left to right.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the quoted and minimum figures.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Ticker printed after both figures.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Tolerance above which the dial warns that the quote can slip.

props.name: lowAt
props.description: Tolerance below which the dial warns the trade may not settle.

props.name: max
props.description: Ceiling the custom field clamps to.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The stops are a radio group with a roving tabindex: Left/Up and Right/Down step without wrapping, Home and End jump to the ends, Space selects. The custom field is a real decimal input one Tab past them.
An empty field means a preset owns the tolerance and a filled one means the field does, so the two can never both claim it; emptying the field returns to the first preset.
The threshold note carries the warning in words as well as in the warn tint, and a debounced visually hidden status line reads the settled tolerance and minimum.
Under reduced motion the knob appears on its stop with no travel and the digits swap in place — the minimum still changes, because what the tolerance costs is the information.

items.title: Pool Share
items.tagline: Your slice of the pool.
items.description: A liquidity position drawn as one wedge of a ring, whose arc grows on glide when you add — one number settling over 450ms rather than a bar snapping. The position and fees roll their digits on snap and the added sum stamps over the ring on recoil, while hovering the ring or pressing the totals control cross-fades the readings to the pool's own. The control is a real aria-pressed button, so the keyboard reaches the second reading exactly as the pointer does and Escape returns to your share.

props.name: poolName
props.description: The pair's name, e.g. "BSN / FRN".

props.name: contributed
props.description: Your position's value in the pool; the wedge is this against poolTotal.

props.name: poolTotal
props.description: The pool's total value.

props.name: fees
props.description: Fees earned so far; rolls when it changes.

props.name: reserves
props.description: { symbol, amount } per side, printed as the pool's totals reading.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every cash figure.

props.name: addStep
props.description: The sum the Add control offers.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Fires from the Add press; raise contributed and the wedge follows.

props.name: showTotals / defaultShowTotals
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned state of the second reading; hover borrows it transiently on top.

props.name: onShowTotalsChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that changed the pinned reading.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the Add control and the Pool totals toggle, which share one height; Enter or Space presses them and Escape on the toggle returns to your share.
The SVG is decorative: the share is exposed as a visually hidden role="meter" with a spoken aria-valuetext, and every figure the ring draws is printed as text.
Both readings are two rows of the same shape in one grid cell, so nothing reserves room for a taller state.
Under reduced motion the wedge still grows and the figures still change, but on a short tween, and the stamp appears in place rather than rising.

items.title: Stake Lock
items.tagline: Lock it up; watch it earn.
items.description: A staking card whose term rail is exact under the finger while a drag is live and settles onto its detent on snap when the pointer lifts, with the projected yield rolling its digits on snap beside it. Locking drops a padlock's shackle into its body on snap and starts an unlock countdown that stops while the tab is hidden and catches up when it returns; cancelling early arms first and opens the shackle on flick with no bounce. The rail is a real slider — arrows move a detent, Page keys move two, Home and End reach the shortest and longest term.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum being staked.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Ticker printed after every figure.

props.name: terms
props.description: The detents: { days, apr }, ascending by days.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial term, in days.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that moved the term.

props.name: locked / defaultLocked
props.description: Controlled or initial lock state.

props.name: onLockedChange
props.description: Fires from the press that locked, cancelled, or unstaked.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the stake and the projected yield.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The rail is role="slider": Left/Down and Right/Up move one detent, PageUp and PageDown move two, Home and End jump to the shortest and longest term. While locked it is aria-disabled and refuses both pointer and key.
Pointer capture waits for 4px of travel and is taken and released inside try/catch, so a plain press sets the nearest detent and a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
Cancelling early arms the button first and names the consequence in its accessible name; a matured term turns the same button into a plain Unstake with no arming.
The countdown is a role="timer" with aria-live off — the two transitions are announced instead — and its interval stops while the document is hidden, catching up when it returns.
Under reduced motion the knob jumps between detents, the shackle swaps between open and shut, and the digits change in place; the countdown still ticks.

items.title: Yield Curve
items.tagline: Longer lock, higher rate.
items.description: Rates plotted against lock length as one Catmull-Rom path that draws itself with pathLength on glide, once, so that afterwards the only thing moving is the marker. Dragging picks the nearest term and the marker travels to it on snap with a guide dropping to the axis, the chosen point lifting off its own curve into a halo while the callout rolls its digits and glides to stay over its node. The plot is a real slider: arrows step a term, Page keys move two, Home and End reach the shortest and longest.

props.name: points
props.description: The curve: { days, apr }, ascending by days. Two points or more.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial chosen term, in days.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the pointer or key that moved the marker.

props.name: amount
props.description: Principal; given it, the callout prints what the chosen term earns.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the earnings figure.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The plot is role="slider": Left/Down and Right/Up step one term without wrapping, PageUp and PageDown move two, Home and End jump to the shortest and longest.

Pointer capture waits for 4px of travel and is taken and released inside try/catch, so a plain press sets the nearest term and a synthetic sweep cannot throw; the plot is touch-none so a drag does not scroll the page.
Every coordinate is rounded before it reaches an attribute, because Node and the browser can differ in the last digits of a square root and a mismatched attribute is a hydration error.
The callout's width and the plot's are measured with a ResizeObserver and its travel clamped between them, so it can never leave the plot at any width.
Under reduced motion the curve is already drawn, the marker jumps without travel or lift, and the digits swap in place.

items.title: Route Split
items.tagline: One trade, many roads.
items.description: One trade drawn as the several roads it takes: each leg is a curve whose stroke width is its share, and the amount travels along it as a dash flowing on a linear ease. A changed split re-lays the widths on glide, and pinning a road lands its label chip on snap. The legend is the accessible surface — real buttons on a roving tabindex where Up and Down step, Home and End jump, Enter pins the reading so the pointer can leave, and Escape unpins.

props.name: legs
props.description: { id, venue, share } per road, in draw order; shares are weights and are normalised.

props.name: amount
props.description: The total being routed; each road carries amount × share.

props.name: from
props.description: Source ticker, printed in the left pill.

props.name: to
props.description: Destination ticker, printed in the right pill.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount, in the legend and in the spoken sentences.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned leg; hover and focus preview on top of it without changing it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that changed the pin.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires whenever the read leg changes, by hover, focus or pin.

props.name: flowing
props.description: Runs the dash flow; ignored under reduced motion and paused while the document is hidden.

props.name: height
props.description: Diagram height in px; the width is fluid and measured with a ResizeObserver.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: The legend carries a roving tabindex: Up and Down (or Left and Right) step between roads, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter and Space pin a road, Escape unpins without losing focus.
The SVG is aria-hidden — every figure it draws is printed in the legend, and each button is named by a sentence carrying its share and amount.
The dash flow is one shared motion value transformed per road, and it stops while the document is hidden.
Under reduced motion the roads draw solid and still carry their widths, because the split is the information.

items.title: Approve Step
items.tagline: Allow, then swap.
items.description: Two controls in one row where the second cannot be reached until the first has finished. Approving turns a ring at a constant rate; approval collapses the button to a tick chip that slides aside on glide while Swap takes the width it left, then wakes into it with a single snap from 0.98 and stamps its tick on recoil once the trade lands. Swap is never disabled — it carries aria-disabled so the keyboard reaches it and hears why it is asleep, and every state arrives through the status prop, so the control never invents time.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: Controlled or initial state: idle, approving, approved, swapping, done or failed.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires from the press that moved the control into a pending state.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Fires from the Approve (or Retry) press; the host does the work and sets status.

props.name: onSwap
props.description: Fires from the Swap press; the host does the work and sets status.

props.name: amount
props.description: The sum being approved, in symbol.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Ticker being approved, e.g. "BSN".

props.name: receive
props.description: The estimated sum received, in receiveSymbol.

props.name: receiveSymbol
props.description: Ticker received, e.g. "FRN".

props.name: format
props.description: Formats both sums, in the labels and in the spoken sentences.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The line shown under the row while status is failed.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches Approve then Swap; Enter and Space press them. Swap carries aria-disabled rather than disabled, so it stays in the tab order and explains itself, and focus is handed to it once approval lands.
A pending control carries aria-busy and keeps its name; approval and completion are announced once each by a visually hidden role="status", never during the ring.
A failed approval returns the button as Retry with a role="alert" line and no celebration.
Under reduced motion the ring holds still and says "Approving" in words, and the chip and the width swap instantly.

items.title: Harvest Tap
items.tagline: Collect what has accrued.
items.description: An accrued-rewards figure that climbs from a motion value rather than state, so it runs continuously without a render per frame, and holds while the document is hidden. Harvesting reads the figure in the press handler and sweeps a ghost of it into the balance on glide over the distance actually measured between the two rows, rolls the balance's digits on snap, and drops the emptied row back to zero on recoil. The Harvest button is a real button that disables itself below minHarvest, and the collected sum is announced once on the press rather than per tick.

props.name: balance
props.description: The collected balance; its digits roll when it changes.

props.name: accrued
props.description: The figure the tap starts from; changing it reseeds the climbing readout.

props.name: rate
props.description: Units accrued per second while accruing.

props.name: accruing
props.description: Runs the climb; paused while the document is hidden.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Ticker for both figures, e.g. "BSN".

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every figure, in the readouts and the spoken sentences.

props.name: minHarvest
props.description: Below this the Harvest button is disabled and names the threshold.

props.name: onHarvest
props.description: Fires from the press, carrying the figure at the moment it was pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the Harvest button; Enter and Space press it. It is genuinely disabled below minHarvest and describes the threshold rather than failing silently.

The climbing figure is aria-hidden — a number changing every frame is noise — and the rate is stated once instead; a visually hidden role="status" announces the collected sum and the new balance on the press.
The climb runs only while the accruing prop is true and the document is visible, and it is stopped in the effect's cleanup.
Under reduced motion the figure still climbs and the balance still changes, but nothing sweeps or bounces and the digits swap in place.

items.title: Impermanent Meter
items.tagline: What the pool cost you against holding.
items.description: Two bars on one scale — what a position would be worth held, and what it is worth pooled — with the shortfall between their ends drawn as hatching that fills on glide as prices diverge, while the percentage rolls its digits on snap. The gap is derived from the pool's own arithmetic rather than handed in, and fees are netted off it honestly. Hovering the gap or pressing the Difference row opens a breakdown whose height is measured rather than reserved; Escape closes it.

props.name: deposit
props.description: Position value at entry; both bars are scaled from it.

props.name: priceRatio
props.description: Price of the pair now against entry — 1 is unchanged, 2 has doubled.

props.name: feesEarned
props.description: Fees taken since entry; nets off the shortfall in the breakdown.

props.name: pair
props.description: The two tickers, named in the breakdown.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every cash figure.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Shortfall fraction at which the gap turns warn.

props.name: dangerAt
props.description: Shortfall fraction at which it turns danger.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or initial pinned state of the breakdown; hover previews it on top.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires from the press or the Escape that changed the pinned state.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Tab reaches the Difference row, which carries aria-expanded and aria-controls; Enter and Space open the breakdown and Escape closes it without losing focus. The hatched gap repeats the same hover and click as a pointer shortcut, never as the only path.
The graphic is aria-hidden; a visually hidden role="meter" carries the shortfall percentage and an aria-valuetext sentence naming both values and the net after fees.
Severity is carried by a word — None, Slight, Notable, Heavy — as well as a tone, and the shortfall is hatched rather than tinted, so neither reading depends on colour.
Under reduced motion the gap still fills and the figures still change, on a fast tween with no overshoot.

items.title: Liquidity Range
items.tagline: Set the band where you earn.
items.description: A price axis with the pool's depth drawn as a procedural curve and two handles that set the earning band; the curve is drawn twice, dim across the axis and bright inside a window sized to the band, so the earning stretch is the same curve lit. Dragging tracks the pointer 1:1 with no spring, while a keyboard step glides the band on snap and the covered depth counts from a motion value. The price marker breathes while it is inside the band and goes still — and says so in words — once it is not.

props.name: bins
props.description: { price, depth } samples in ascending price; their ends set the axis.

props.name: price
props.description: The market price, drawn as the marker and compared against the band.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial band, low then high.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on every drag frame and every keyboard step.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every price, in the readouts and in aria-valuetext.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow-key step; Shift and the Page keys multiply it by ten.

props.name: unit
props.description: What a price is quoted in, e.g. "FRN per BSN"; spoken in aria-valuetext.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px; the width is fluid and measured.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading; omit it and pass aria-label.

usageNotes: Two role="slider" handles: Left and Right step, Shift steps ten at a time, PageUp and PageDown step ten, Home and End run to the ends, and the handles stop one step apart rather than crossing.
A press captures the pointer only after 4px of travel, inside try/catch, so a plain click still moves the nearer handle and a synthetic sweep cannot throw.
The plot is aria-hidden — the band, price, covered depth and every bin are printed as text — and whether the price is earning is stated in words, not by the pulse or the colour.
Under reduced motion the marker holds a steady halo instead of breathing and nothing springs; the lit stretch still lights.

items.title: Envelope Row
items.tagline: Money set aside, on purpose.
items.description: Budget envelopes as a row of cards, each filling from the bottom with the share of its allocation already spent — a scaleY on glide, because an amount settles rather than switches. Dragging the coin out of a card's socket lifts it onto two motion values that track the pointer with no render per frame; releasing over another envelope commits the transfer and the coin flies the rest of the way on glide while the remainder chips settle on recoil. Enter or Space lifts the coin, Arrow keys walk the row, a second Enter or Space drops it and Escape puts it back.

props.name: envelopes / defaultEnvelopes
props.description: Controlled or initial envelopes: { id, name, allocated, spent }.

props.name: onEnvelopesChange
props.description: Fires from the drop or key that moved money, with the whole new row.

props.name: onTransfer
props.type: (from: string, to: string, amount: number) => void
props.description: Fires from the same event with just the move.

props.name: step
props.description: Money moved by one drop.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats every amount; defaults to an explicit en-US currency formatter so the server and the client agree.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the row; printed above it and used for assistive technology.

usageNotes: A roving tabindex over the cards: Arrow keys move, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space lifts and drops the coin, Escape puts it back. A plain click runs the same two-tap trade.
Only the coin socket takes a drag — the row still scrolls under a thumb everywhere else — and the pointer is captured after 4px of travel so a tap is never swallowed.
Under reduced motion the coin never travels: it waits on its source card and fades at the drop, while the fills still fill on a tween because that is the information.

items.title: Spend Ring
items.tagline: The month, as a ring.
items.description: The month drawn once, as a ring: the arc grows clockwise with the share of the budget already spent through strokeDashoffset on a pathLength circle, settling on glide because a total is a quantity arriving rather than a switch flipping. A one-notch dash walks the same circle at the month's own progress, so fill behind the mark reads on pace and fill past it turns warn, while spend past the budget wraps a second danger arc back over the ring's head on snap. The centre figure counts through a motion value, and a two-stop radio group under the ring swaps it between spent and left with Arrow keys, Home and End, its knob travelling on a shared layoutId.

props.name: spent
props.description: Money spent this month. May exceed the budget; the overage is drawn.

props.name: budget
